mem.en: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
mem.ko: 너희 염려를 다 그에게 맡기라. 이는 그가 너희를 돌보심이라.
mem.tip: '너희 염려를 다(Casting all your care) / 그에게 맡기라(upon him) / 그가 돌보심이라(for he careth for you)' 세 마디로 끊어 손동작과 함께 외워 보세요.
mem.deep: 그리스어 '맡기라'(ἐπιρίπτω, 에피립토)는 짐을 통째로 던져 올리는 강한 동작을 가리키며, '염려'(μέριμνα, 메림나)는 마음을 갈라놓는 근심을 뜻합니다. 이는 시편 55편 22절 '네 짐을 여호와께 맡기라'를 직접 반향하며, 빌립보서 4장 6절 '아무것도 염려하지 말고 기도와 간구로 하나님께 아뢰라'와 마태복음 6장 25~34절의 가르침과도 교차 확증됩니다. 근본주의 침례신학은 이 맡김이 염려를 그친 뒤에야 얻는 조건적 은혜가 아니라, 이미 값없는 은혜로 구원받아 하나님의 자녀 된 자가 그분의 아버지 되심을 신뢰하며 누리는 특권임을 강조합니다. 참된 믿음은 시험과 겸손의 자리에서 염려를 홀로 짊어지지 않고 아버지께 내어드리는 삶의 열매로 나타납니다.

spoon: 오늘 마음을 무겁게 하는 염려가 있다면, 혼자 붙들지 말고 '그가 나를 돌보신다'는 확신으로 다 하나님께 맡겨 보세요.

title: Stand Firm: Resist the Devil and Rest in God's Grace
titleKo: 굳게 서라 - 마귀를 대적하고 은혜에 거하라

verses.en: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verses.ko: 정신을 차리고 깨어 있으라. 너희 대적 마귀가 우는 사자같이 두루 다니며 삼킬 자를 찾나니,
verses.ez: Stay calm and stay alert, because your enemy the devil is prowling around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to devour.

verses.en: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
verses.ko: 너희는 믿음에 굳게 서서 그를 대적하라. 이는 세상에 있는 너희 형제들도 같은 고난을 겪고 있음을 너희가 앎이라.
verses.ez: Stand firm against him, staying strong in your faith, knowing that believers all over the world are going through the same kinds of suffering.

verses.en: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
verses.ko: 모든 은혜의 하나님 곧 그리스도 예수 안에서 너희를 그의 영원한 영광에 들어가게 부르신 이가, 너희가 잠시 고난을 받은 후에 친히 너희를 온전하게 하시며 굳건하게 하시며 강하게 하시며 터를 견고하게 하시리라.
verses.ez: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory through Christ Jesus, will himself restore you, make you strong, and give you a firm foundation.

verses.en: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.ko: 그에게 영광과 권능이 세세무궁토록 있을지어다. 아멘.
verses.ez: To him be power and glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.en: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
verses.ko: 내가 신실한 형제로 여기는 실루아노의 손을 빌려 너희에게 간략히 써서 권하고 증언하노니, 이것이 하나님의 참된 은혜라. 너희는 이 은혜에 굳게 서라.
verses.ez: I have written this short letter to you with the help of Silvanus, whom I consider a faithful brother, to encourage you and to assure you that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.

verses.en: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

verses.en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

verses.ez: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be with all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

mem.en: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
mem.ko: 모든 은혜의 하나님 곧 그리스도 예수 안에서 너희를 그의 영원한 영광에 들어가게 부르신 이가, 너희가 잠시 고난을 받은 후에 친히 너희를 온전하게 하시며 굳건하게 하시며 강하게 하시며 터를 견고하게 하시리라.
mem.tip: '모든 은혜의 하나님이(the God of all grace) / 잠시 고난 후에(after that ye have suffered a while) / 온전·굳건·강함·견고케(perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle)' 세 마디로 끊어 외워 보세요.
mem.deep: 그리스어로 이 절에는 네 동사 '카타르티조(온전하게 하다), 스테리조(굳건하게 하다), 스데노오(강하게 하다), 데멜리오오(터를 견고하게 하다)'가 겹겹이 쌓여, 고난 뒤 하나님이 신자를 회복시키시는 일이 결코 부분적이지 않고 완전함을 보여 줍니다. '잠시(올리곤)'는 고난의 유한함을, '모든 은혜의 하나님'은 그 회복의 근원이 오직 은혜임을 강조합니다. 이는 로마서 8장 28~29절 '모든 것이 합력하여 선을 이루느니라'와 야고보서 1장 2~4절의 인내를 통한 온전함과 교차 확증됩니다. 근본주의 침례신학은 이 온전케 하심이 인간의 노력으로 얻는 것이 아니라 그리스도 예수를 통해 값없이 주어진 영원한 영광의 부르심에 근거하며, 고난 중에도 흔들리지 않는 견고한 믿음의 삶으로 그 은혜의 열매가 나타난다고 가르칩니다.

spoon: 오늘 견디기 힘든 고난이 있다면, 이 순간이 잠깐임을 기억하며 모든 은혜의 하나님께서 친히 나를 굳건하게 세우신다는 약속을 붙들어 보세요.

title: Precious Faith and the Divine Nature

verses.en: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
verses.ko: 예수 그리스도의 종이요 사도인 시몬 베드로는, 우리 하나님과 구주 예수 그리스도의 의로 말미암아 우리와 같이 보배로운 믿음을 받은 자들에게 쓰노라.
verses.ez: This letter is from Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ. I am writing to you who have received a faith as precious as ours, given to us by the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
verses.ko: 하나님과 우리 주 예수를 앎으로 말미암아 은혜와 평강이 너희에게 더욱 넘칠지어다.
verses.ez: May God give you more and more grace and peace as you come to know him and Jesus our Lord better.

verses.en: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
verses.ko: 그의 신기한 능력이 생명과 경건에 속한 모든 것을 우리에게 주셨으니, 이는 자기의 영광과 덕으로써 우리를 부르신 이를 앎으로 말미암음이라.
verses.ez: By his divine power, God has given us everything we need for living a godly life. We received all of this by coming to know him, the one who called us by his own glory and goodness.

verses.en: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
verses.ko: 이로써 그가 보배롭고 지극히 큰 약속을 우리에게 주사, 이 약속으로 말미암아 너희가 정욕으로 인하여 세상에 있는 썩어질 것을 피하여 신성한 성품에 참여하는 자가 되게 하려 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: And because of his glory and goodness, he has given us great and precious promises. Through these promises you can share in his divine nature and escape the decay in this world caused by human desire.

verses.en: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
verses.ko: 그러므로 너희가 더욱 힘써, 너희 믿음에 덕을, 덕에 지식을,
verses.ez: So make every effort to add goodness to your faith, and to your goodness add knowledge,

verses.en: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
verses.ko: 지식에 절제를, 절제에 인내를, 인내에 경건을,
verses.ez: and to your knowledge add self-control, and to your self-control add patient endurance, and to your endurance add godliness,

verses.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
verses.ko: 경건에 형제 우애를, 형제 우애에 사랑을 더하라.
verses.ez: and to your godliness add brotherly affection, and to your brotherly affection add love.

title: Make Your Calling and Election Sure

verses.en: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ko: 이것이 너희에게 있어 넘치면, 너희가 우리 주 예수 그리스도를 앎에 게으르지 아니하고 열매 없는 자가 되지 아니하게 하려니와,
verses.ez: The more you grow in these qualities, the more useful and fruitful you will be in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
verses.ko: 이런 것이 없는 자는 맹인이라 멀리 보지 못하고, 그 옛 죄가 깨끗하게 된 것을 잊었느니라.
verses.ez: But anyone who does not have these qualities is short-sighted, even blind, and has forgotten that he was cleansed from his past sins.

verses.en: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
verses.ko: 그러므로 형제들아, 더욱 힘써 너희의 부르심과 택하심을 굳게 하라. 너희가 이것을 행하면 결코 넘어지지 아니하리라.
verses.ez: So, brothers and sisters, work all the harder to confirm that God really has called and chosen you. If you do these things, you will never stumble.

verses.en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
verses.ko: 이같이 하면 우리 주 곧 구주 예수 그리스도의 영원한 왕국에 들어감을 너희에게 넉넉히 주시리라.
verses.ez: Then God will give you a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
verses.ko: 그러므로 너희가 이것을 알고 또 이미 받은 진리에 굳게 섰으나, 내가 항상 이것을 너희에게 일깨우기를 게을리하지 아니하리라.
verses.ez: So I will always remind you about these things, even though you already know them and are firmly established in the truth you now have.

verses.en: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
verses.ko: 내가 이 장막에 있는 동안 너희를 일깨워 생각나게 함이 옳은 줄로 여기노니,
verses.ez: Yes, I think it is right to keep on reminding you as long as I live in this earthly tent.

verses.en: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
verses.ko: 이는 우리 주 예수 그리스도께서 내게 보이신 것같이, 내가 이 장막을 벗을 날이 속히 올 줄을 앎이라.
verses.ez: For I know that I must soon lay this tent aside, just as our Lord Jesus Christ showed me.

title: Eyewitnesses of His Majesty and the Sure Word
titleKo: 그 위엄을 본 증인과 더 확실한 말씀

verses.en: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
verses.ko: 내가 떠난 후에라도 너희가 항상 이것을 기억하게 하려고 힘쓰리라.
verses.ez: I will make every effort so that after I am gone you will be able to remember these things at all times.

verses.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.ko: 우리가 우리 주 예수 그리스도의 능력과 강림하심을 너희에게 알릴 때에, 교묘히 꾸민 이야기를 좇은 것이 아니요 그의 위엄을 친히 눈으로 본 자라.
verses.ez: When we told you about the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not following clever made-up stories. We saw his majesty with our own eyes.

verses.en: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.ko: 그가 아버지 하나님께로부터 존귀와 영광을 받으실 때에, 지극히 큰 영광 가운데서 그에게 이런 소리가 임하였으니 "이는 내 사랑하는 아들이요 내가 기뻐하는 자라" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice from the Majestic Glory said to him, "This is my dearly loved Son, who brings me great joy."

verses.en: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
verses.ko: 우리가 그와 함께 거룩한 산에 있을 때에 하늘로부터 난 이 소리를 친히 들었노라.
verses.ez: We ourselves heard that voice from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

verses.en: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
verses.ko: 또 우리에게는 더 확실한 예언의 말씀이 있으니, 너희가 이것을 어두운 데를 비추는 등불같이 여겨, 날이 새어 샛별이 너희 마음에 떠오르기까지 주의하는 것이 옳으니라.
verses.ez: We also have the message of the prophets, which is even more certain. You would do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

verses.en: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
verses.ko: 먼저 알 것은 이것이니, 곧 성경의 모든 예언은 사사로이 풀 것이 아니니라.
verses.ez: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture came from the prophet's own understanding.

verses.en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
verses.ko: 예언은 결코 사람의 뜻으로 낸 것이 아니요, 오직 성령의 감동하심을 받은 사람들이 하나님께 받아 말한 것임이라.
verses.ez: For prophecy never came from human initiative. Instead, holy people spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

title: False Teachers and the God Who Knows How to Deliver
titleKo: 거짓 선생들, 그리고 건지실 줄 아시는 하나님

verses.en: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.ko: 그러나 백성 가운데 거짓 선지자들이 일어났던 것같이, 너희 가운데도 거짓 선생들이 있으리라. 그들이 멸망케 할 이단을 몰래 끌어들여, 자기들을 사신 주를 부인하고 임박한 멸망을 스스로 불러들이느니라.
verses.ez: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly bring in destructive teachings, even denying the Master who bought them, and so bring quick ruin on themselves.

verses.en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
verses.ko: 많은 사람이 그들의 음란한 행실을 좇으리니, 이로 말미암아 진리의 도가 비방을 받으리라.
verses.ez: Many will follow their shameful ways, and because of them the way of truth will be spoken against.

verses.en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
verses.ko: 그들이 탐심으로 거짓말을 지어 너희를 이용하여 이득을 취하리니, 그들에 대한 심판은 오래전부터 지체하지 아니하며 그 멸망은 졸지 아니하느니라.
verses.ez: In their greed they will exploit you with made-up stories. Their condemnation, decided long ago, is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.

verses.en: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.ko: 하나님께서 범죄한 천사들을 아끼지 아니하시고 지옥에 던져 어둠의 사슬에 매어 심판 때까지 가두어 두셨으며,
verses.ez: For God did not spare the angels who sinned. He threw them into hell and held them in chains of darkness, keeping them until the judgment.

verses.en: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.ko: 옛 세상을 아끼지 아니하시고 오직 의를 전파하던 노아와 그 일곱 식구만을 보존하시고, 경건치 아니한 세상에 홍수를 내리셨으며,
verses.ez: And he did not spare the ancient world. He brought a flood on that ungodly world, but he protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, along with seven others.

verses.en: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
verses.ko: 소돔과 고모라 성을 멸하시기로 정하사 재가 되게 하여, 후에 경건치 아니하게 살 자들에게 본을 삼으셨으며,
verses.ez: He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, burning them to ashes, and made them an example of what will happen to ungodly people.

verses.en: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
verses.ko: 무법한 자들의 더러운 행실로 고통받던 의로운 롯을 건지셨느니라.
verses.ez: But he rescued Lot, a righteous man who was distressed by the filthy behavior of lawless people.

title: The Lord Knows How to Rescue the Godly
titleKo: 주께서는 경건한 자를 건지실 줄 아신다

verses.en: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
verses.ko: 이 의인이 그들 가운데 살며 보고 들음으로, 날마다 그 불법한 행실로 인하여 그 의로운 심령에 고통을 받았느니라.
verses.ez: (For that righteous man lived among them day after day, and what he saw and heard tormented his righteous soul because of their lawless deeds.)

verses.en: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
verses.ko: 주께서는 경건한 자를 시험에서 건지시고 불의한 자를 형벌 아래 두어 심판 날까지 가두실 줄을 아시느니라.
verses.ez: So the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their trials and how to hold the unrighteous for punishment until the day of judgment.

verses.en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
verses.ko: 육체를 따라 더러운 정욕 가운데 행하며 주관하는 권세를 멸시하는 자들에게는 더욱 그러하시리라. 이들은 담대하고 고집이 세어 영광 있는 자들을 비방하기를 두려워하지 아니하나,
verses.ez: This is especially true of those who follow their corrupt desires and despise authority. Bold and arrogant, they are not afraid to slander glorious beings.

verses.en: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
verses.ko: 더 큰 힘과 능력을 지닌 천사들도 주 앞에서 그들을 거슬러 비방하는 고발을 하지 아니하느니라.
verses.ez: Yet even angels, who are greater in strength and power, do not bring slanderous accusations against them before the Lord.

verses.en: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
verses.ko: 그러나 이 사람들은 본래 잡혀 죽기 위해 난 이성 없는 짐승같아, 알지 못하는 것을 비방하다가 그 멸망 가운데서 멸망을 당하며,
verses.ez: But these people are like unthinking animals, born only to be caught and destroyed. They speak evil of what they do not understand, and they will perish in their own corruption.

verses.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
verses.ko: 불의의 값으로 불의를 받으리라. 그들은 대낮에 흥청거리는 것을 낙으로 여기는 자들이라. 점이요 흠이라, 너희와 함께 잔치하며 자기 속임수에 빠져 즐기느니라.
verses.ez: They will be paid back with harm for the harm they have done. Their idea of pleasure is to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions while they feast with you.

verses.en: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
verses.ko: 음심이 가득한 눈을 가지고 죄짓기를 그치지 아니하며, 굳세지 못한 영혼을 미혹하고, 탐욕에 단련된 마음을 품은 자들이니 곧 저주의 자식이라.
verses.ez: With eyes full of adultery, they never stop sinning. They lure unstable people, and their hearts are trained in greed. They are under a curse.

title: Wells Without Water: Freedom That Enslaves
titleKo: 물 없는 샘 — 자유를 약속하나 종이 된 자들

verses.en: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
verses.ko: 그들이 바른길을 버리고 미혹되어 브올의 아들 발람의 길을 좇았으니, 발람은 불의의 삯을 사랑하다가,
verses.ez: They have left the straight road and wandered off, following the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the pay he got for doing wrong.

verses.en: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
verses.ko: 그 불법으로 인하여 책망을 받았느니라. 말 못 하는 나귀가 사람의 소리로 말하여 그 선지자의 미친 행동을 막았느니라.
verses.ez: But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing. A donkey that cannot talk spoke with a human voice and stopped the prophet's madness.

verses.en: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
verses.ko: 이 사람들은 물 없는 샘이요 광풍에 밀려가는 안개니, 그들을 위하여 캄캄한 어둠이 예비되어 있느니라.
verses.ez: These people are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. The deepest darkness is reserved for them.

verses.en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
verses.ko: 그들이 허탄하고 큰소리치는 말을 토하며, 그릇된 길에서 갓 벗어난 자들을 육체의 정욕과 방탕으로 꾀어내느니라.
verses.ez: They speak empty, boastful words, and by appealing to lustful desires they lure back people who have just escaped from those living in error.

verses.en: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
verses.ko: 그들에게 자유를 약속하나 자기들은 부패의 종이라. 누구든지 진 자는 이긴 자의 종이 되는 법이니라.
verses.ez: They promise freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption — for people are slaves to whatever has defeated them.

verses.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
verses.ko: 만일 그들이 주 곧 구주 예수 그리스도를 앎으로 세상의 더러움을 피한 후에 다시 그 가운데 얽매여 지면, 그 마지막 형편이 처음보다 더 심하니라.
verses.ez: If they have escaped the pollution of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, and then get tangled up in it again and are defeated, they are worse off at the end than at the beginning.

verses.en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
verses.ko: 의의 도를 안 후에 자기에게 전해 받은 거룩한 계명을 저버리는 것보다, 차라리 그것을 알지 못하였던 편이 그들에게 나았으리라.
verses.ez: It would have been better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than to know it and then turn away from the holy command that was given to them.

verses.en: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
verses.ko: 참된 속담에 이르기를 "개가 그 토한 것을 도로 먹고, 돼지가 씻었다가 다시 진창에 뒹군다" 한 것이 그들에게 그대로 일어났느니라.
verses.ez: What has happened to them proves the true proverb: "A dog returns to its vomit," and "A washed pig goes back to rolling in the mud."

verses.en: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 내가 이제 이 둘째 편지를 너희에게 쓰노니, 이 두 편지로 너희를 일깨워 순전한 마음을 생각나게 하노라.
verses.ez: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. In both of them I have tried to stir up your sincere minds by way of reminder.

verses.en: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
verses.ko: 곧 거룩한 선지자들이 미리 한 말씀과 주 곧 구주께서 너희의 사도들을 통하여 주신 계명을 기억하게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: I want you to remember the words spoken long ago by the holy prophets, and the command of our Lord and Savior given through your apostles.

verses.en: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
verses.ko: 먼저 이것을 알라. 곧 마지막 날에 조롱하는 자들이 와서 자기의 정욕을 좇아 행하며 조롱하여,
verses.ez: Above all, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, following their own evil desires.

verses.en: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
verses.ko: 이르되 "주께서 강림하신다는 약속이 어디 있느냐. 조상들이 잠든 이래로 만물이 창조 때부터 그대로 있지 아니하냐" 하리니,
verses.ez: They will say, "Where is this coming he promised? Ever since our ancestors died, everything goes on just as it has since the beginning of creation."

verses.en: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
verses.ko: 이는 그들이 일부러 잊으려 함이라. 곧 하늘이 옛적부터 있었고 땅이 물에서 나와 물로 이루어진 것이 하나님의 말씀으로 된 것이며,
verses.ez: But they deliberately forget that long ago, by God's word, the heavens came into being and the earth was formed out of water and by water.

verses.en: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.ko: 이로 말미암아 그때의 세상이 물에 잠겨 멸망하였느니라.
verses.ez: By these waters the world of that time was flooded and destroyed.

verses.en: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
verses.ko: 그러나 이제의 하늘과 땅은 그 동일한 말씀으로 보존되어, 경건치 아니한 사람들의 심판과 멸망의 날까지 불사르기 위하여 간직되어 있느니라.
verses.ez: By that same word, the present heavens and earth are being kept for fire, reserved for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly people.

title: Not Slack but Longsuffering: The Day of the Lord
titleKo: 더디신 것이 아니라 오래 참으심 — 주의 날

verses.en: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 이 한 가지를 잊지 말라. 주께는 하루가 천 년 같고 천 년이 하루 같으니라.
verses.ez: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

verses.en: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.ko: 주께서는 어떤 이들이 더디다 여기는 것같이 그 약속을 더디 이루시는 것이 아니라, 도리어 너희를 위하여 오래 참으시느니라. 이는 아무도 멸망치 아니하고 다 회개에 이르기를 원하심이라.
verses.ez: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. Instead he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.

verses.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.ko: 그러나 주의 날이 도둑같이 오리니, 그날에 하늘이 큰 소리로 떠나가고 물질이 불에 풀어지며 땅과 그 안에 있는 모든 일이 드러나리라.
verses.ez: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done in it will be laid bare.

verses.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
verses.ko: 이 모든 것이 이렇게 풀어지리니, 너희가 어떠한 사람이 되어야 마땅하냐. 거룩한 행실과 경건함으로,
verses.ez: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You should live holy and godly lives,

verses.en: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
verses.ko: 하나님의 날이 임하기를 바라보고 간절히 사모하라. 그날에 하늘이 불에 타서 풀어지고 물질이 뜨거운 불에 녹아지려니와,
verses.ez: as you look forward to the day of God and speed its coming. That day will bring about the destruction of the heavens by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.

verses.en: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verses.ko: 우리는 그의 약속을 따라 의가 거하는 새 하늘과 새 땅을 바라보느니라.
verses.ez: But in keeping with his promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.

verses.en: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
verses.ko: 그러므로 사랑하는 자들아, 너희가 이것을 바라보나니, 주 앞에서 점도 없고 흠도 없이 평강 가운데 나타나기를 힘쓰라.
verses.ez: So then, dear friends, since you are looking forward to this, make every effort to be found spotless, blameless and at peace with him.

title: Grow in Grace: Beware and Stand Firm
titleKo: 은혜 안에서 자라 가라 — 삼가고 굳게 서라

verses.en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
verses.ko: 또 우리 주의 오래 참으심을 구원으로 여기라. 우리가 사랑하는 형제 바울도 그 받은 지혜를 따라 너희에게 이같이 썼고,
verses.ez: And remember that our Lord's patience gives people time to be saved. This is what our dear brother Paul also wrote to you with the wisdom God gave him.

verses.en: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
verses.ko: 또 그의 모든 편지에도 이런 일에 관하여 말하였으되, 그 가운데 알기 어려운 것이 더러 있으니, 무식하고 굳세지 못한 자들이 다른 성경과 같이 그것도 억지로 풀다가 스스로 멸망에 이르느니라.
verses.ez: He writes about these things in all his letters. Some of his comments are hard to understand, and those who are ignorant and unstable twist them, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

verses.en: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
verses.ko: 그러므로 사랑하는 자들아, 너희가 이것을 미리 알았은즉, 무법한 자들의 미혹에 이끌려 너희의 굳센 데서 떨어질까 삼가라.
verses.ez: So then, dear friends, since you already know this, be on your guard. Do not let the error of lawless people carry you away and cause you to lose your firm footing.

verses.en: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
verses.ko: 오직 우리 주 곧 구주 예수 그리스도의 은혜와 그를 아는 지식에서 자라 가라. 그에게 지금부터 영원한 날까지 영광이 있을지어다. 아멘.
verses.ez: Instead, grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

title: The Word of Life We Have Seen and Touched

verses.en: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
verses.ko: 태초부터 계신 것, 곧 우리가 들은 바요 우리 눈으로 본 바요 우리가 자세히 살피고 우리 손으로 만진 바니, 이는 생명의 말씀에 관함이라.
verses.ez: We are telling you about the one who existed from the beginning — the one we have heard, the one we have seen with our own eyes, the one we looked at and touched with our hands. He is the Word of life.

verses.en: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
verses.ko: 이 생명이 나타나신지라, 우리가 보았고 또 증언하여 너희에게 그 영원한 생명을 전하노니, 곧 아버지와 함께 계시다가 우리에게 나타나신 분이시니라.
verses.ez: (This life was revealed to us. We saw him, and we testify about him. We are telling you about the eternal life who was with the Father and was revealed to us.)

verses.en: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
verses.ko: 우리가 보고 들은 바를 너희에게도 전함은, 너희로 우리와 더불어 사귐을 갖게 하려 함이라. 참으로 우리의 사귐은 아버지와 또 그의 아들 예수 그리스도와 더불어 있느니라.
verses.ez: We tell you what we ourselves have seen and heard so that you may share in this fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

verses.en: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
verses.ko: 우리가 이것을 너희에게 씀은 우리의 기쁨이 충만하게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: We are writing these things so that our joy may be complete.

verses.en: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.ko: 우리가 그에게서 듣고 너희에게 전하는 소식은 이것이니, 곧 하나님은 빛이시라, 그 안에는 어둠이 조금도 없느니라.
verses.ez: This is the message we heard from him and now announce to you: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.

verses.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.ko: 만일 우리가 그와 더불어 사귐이 있다 하면서 어둠 가운데 행하면, 우리는 거짓을 말하는 것이요 진리를 행하지 아니함이라.
verses.ez: So if we say we have fellowship with him but keep on living in darkness, we are lying and not practicing the truth.

verses.en: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.ko: 그러나 그가 빛 가운데 계신 것같이 우리도 빛 가운데 행하면, 우리가 서로 사귐이 있고 그의 아들 예수 그리스도의 피가 우리를 모든 죄에서 깨끗하게 하시느니라.
verses.ez: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.

title: If We Confess Our Sins: Faithful and Just
titleKo: 우리 죄를 자백하면 — 미쁘시고 의로우신 분

verses.en: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.ko: 만일 우리가 죄가 없다 하면, 우리는 스스로 속이는 것이요 진리가 우리 속에 있지 아니하니라.
verses.ez: If we claim we have no sin, we are only fooling ourselves and not living in the truth.

verses.en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.ko: 만일 우리가 우리 죄를 자백하면 그는 미쁘시고 의로우사 우리 죄를 사하시며 모든 불의에서 우리를 깨끗하게 하시느니라.
verses.ez: But if we confess our sins to him, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all wickedness.

verses.en: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.ko: 만일 우리가 범죄하지 아니하였다 하면, 우리는 그를 거짓말하는 분으로 만드는 것이요 그의 말씀이 우리 속에 있지 아니하니라.
verses.ez: If we claim we have not sinned, we are calling God a liar and showing that his word has no place in our hearts.

title: We Have an Advocate with the Father
titleKo: 아버지 앞에 우리를 위한 대언자가 계시다

verses.en: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.ko: 나의 자녀들아, 내가 이것을 너희에게 씀은 너희로 죄를 짓지 않게 하려 함이라. 만일 누가 죄를 지을지라도, 우리에게 아버지 앞에서 우리를 위한 대언자가 계시니, 곧 의로우신 예수 그리스도시라.
verses.ez: My dear children, I am writing this to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate who pleads our case before the Father — Jesus Christ, the one who is truly righteous.

verses.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.ko: 그가 친히 우리 죄를 위한 화목제물이 되셨으니, 우리 죄만 위함이 아니요 또한 온 세상의 죄를 위하심이라.
verses.ez: He himself is the sacrifice that takes away our sins — and not only ours but the sins of the whole world.

verses.en: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.ko: 우리가 그의 계명을 지키면, 이로써 우리가 그를 아는 줄을 알게 되느니라.
verses.ez: And this is how we can be sure that we know him: if we obey his commandments.

verses.en: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
verses.ko: 그를 안다 하면서 그의 계명을 지키지 아니하는 자는 거짓말하는 자요 진리가 그 속에 있지 아니하되,
verses.ez: Anyone who says, "I know God," but does not obey his commandments is a liar, and the truth is not in that person.

verses.en: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
verses.ko: 누구든지 그의 말씀을 지키는 자는 하나님의 사랑이 참으로 그 속에서 온전하게 되나니, 이로써 우리가 그 안에 있는 줄을 아느니라.
verses.ez: But those who obey God's word truly show how completely they love him. That is how we know we are living in him.

verses.en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
verses.ko: 그 안에 거한다 하는 자는 그가 행하신 것같이 자기도 그렇게 행할지니라.
verses.ez: Those who say they live in God should live their lives as Jesus did.

verses.en: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 내가 너희에게 새 계명을 쓰는 것이 아니요 너희가 처음부터 가진 옛 계명이니, 이 옛 계명은 너희가 처음부터 들은 말씀이라.
verses.ez: Dear friends, I am not writing a new commandment for you, but an old one you have had from the beginning. This old commandment is the message you heard from the start.

title: The True Light Now Shines: Love Your Brother

verses.en: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
verses.ko: 다시 내가 너희에게 새 계명을 쓰노니, 이는 그에게와 너희에게 참된 것이라, 이는 어둠이 지나가고 참빛이 이미 비침이니라.
verses.ez: Yet it is also a new commandment I am writing to you, and its truth is seen in him and in you. The darkness is passing away, and the true light is already shining.

verses.en: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
verses.ko: 빛 가운데 있다 하면서 그 형제를 미워하는 자는 지금까지 어둠 가운데 있는 자요,
verses.ez: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates a fellow believer is still in the darkness.

verses.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
verses.ko: 그 형제를 사랑하는 자는 빛 가운데 거하니, 그에게는 거리낄 것이 없느니라.
verses.ez: Anyone who loves a fellow believer is living in the light, and there is nothing in them to make them stumble.

verses.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
verses.ko: 그러나 그 형제를 미워하는 자는 어둠 가운데 있고 어둠 가운데 행하며, 자기가 어디로 가는지 알지 못하나니, 이는 어둠이 그의 눈을 멀게 하였음이라.
verses.ez: But anyone who hates a fellow believer is in darkness and walks in darkness, not knowing where they are going, because the darkness has blinded their eyes.

verses.en: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
verses.ko: 자녀들아, 내가 너희에게 씀은 너희 죄가 그의 이름을 인하여 사하여졌음이라.
verses.ez: I am writing to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven through Jesus.

verses.en: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
verses.ko: 아비들아, 내가 너희에게 씀은 너희가 처음부터 계신 분을 알았음이라. 청년들아, 내가 너희에게 씀은 너희가 악한 자를 이기었음이라. 어린 자녀들아, 내가 너희에게 씀은 너희가 아버지를 알았음이라.
verses.ez: I am writing to you who are mature because you know him who existed from the beginning. I am writing to you who are young because you have won your battle with the evil one. I am writing to you, dear children, because you know the Father.

verses.en: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
verses.ko: 아비들아, 내가 너희에게 쓴 것은 너희가 처음부터 계신 분을 알았음이라. 청년들아, 내가 너희에게 쓴 것은 너희가 강하고 하나님의 말씀이 너희 속에 거하며 너희가 악한 자를 이기었음이라.
verses.ez: I have written to you who are mature because you know him who existed from the beginning. I have written to you who are young because you are strong, God's word lives in your hearts, and you have won your battle with the evil one.

title: Love Not the World: What Passes and What Abides
titleKo: 세상을 사랑하지 말라 — 지나가는 것과 영원한 것

verses.en: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.ko: 이 세상이나 세상에 있는 것들을 사랑하지 말라. 누구든지 세상을 사랑하면 아버지의 사랑이 그 속에 있지 아니하니,
verses.ez: Do not love this world nor the things it offers you. For when you love the world, you do not have the love of the Father in you.

verses.en: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.ko: 이는 세상에 있는 모든 것 곧 육신의 정욕과 안목의 정욕과 이생의 자랑이 다 아버지께로부터 온 것이 아니요 세상으로부터 온 것임이라.
verses.ez: For the world offers only a craving for physical pleasure, a craving for everything we see, and pride in our achievements. These do not come from the Father, but from this world.

verses.en: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
verses.ko: 이 세상도 그 정욕도 지나가되, 오직 하나님의 뜻을 행하는 자는 영원히 거하느니라.
verses.ez: And this world is fading away, along with everything it craves. But anyone who does what pleases God will live forever.

verses.en: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
verses.ko: 어린 자녀들아, 지금은 마지막 때라. 적그리스도가 오리라 함을 너희가 들은 것같이 지금도 많은 적그리스도가 일어났으니, 이로써 우리가 마지막 때인 줄을 아노라.
verses.ez: Dear children, the last hour is here. You have heard that the Antichrist is coming, and already many such antichrists have appeared. From this we know that the last hour has come.

verses.en: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
verses.ko: 그들이 우리에게서 나갔으나 우리에게 속한 자가 아니었나니, 만일 우리에게 속하였더라면 우리와 함께 거하였으려니와, 그들이 나간 것은 다 우리에게 속하지 아니함을 드러내려 함이라.
verses.ez: These people left our churches, but they never really belonged with us. If they had, they would have stayed with us. When they left, it showed that none of them truly belonged to us.

verses.en: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
verses.ko: 너희는 거룩하신 분께로부터 기름 부으심을 받았으니, 너희가 모든 것을 아느니라.
verses.ez: But you have received the Holy Spirit from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

verses.en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
verses.ko: 내가 너희에게 쓴 것은 너희가 진리를 알지 못하여서가 아니요 도리어 너희가 그것을 알고 또 모든 거짓은 진리에서 나오지 아니함을 알기 때문이라.
verses.ez: So I am writing to you not because you do not know the truth, but because you know the difference between truth and lies.

title: Abide in Him: The Anointing That Teaches
titleKo: 그 안에 거하라 — 가르치시는 기름 부으심

verses.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.ko: 거짓말하는 자가 누구냐 예수께서 그리스도이심을 부인하는 자가 아니냐 아버지와 아들을 부인하는 그가 곧 적그리스도라.
verses.ez: And who is a liar? Anyone who says that Jesus is not the Christ. Anyone who denies the Father and the Son is an antichrist.

verses.en: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
verses.ko: 누구든지 아들을 부인하는 자에게는 아버지도 없으되, 아들을 시인하는 자에게는 아버지도 있느니라.
verses.ez: Anyone who denies the Son does not have the Father either. But anyone who acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

verses.en: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.ko: 그러므로 너희는 처음부터 들은 것을 너희 속에 거하게 하라. 처음부터 들은 것이 너희 속에 거하면 너희도 아들과 아버지 안에 거하리라.
verses.ez: So you must remain faithful to what you have been taught from the beginning. If you do, you will remain in fellowship with the Son and with the Father.

verses.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
verses.ko: 그가 우리에게 친히 약속하신 것은 이것이니, 곧 영생이라.
verses.ez: And in this fellowship we enjoy the eternal life he promised us.

verses.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
verses.ko: 내가 너희를 미혹하는 자들에 관하여 이것을 너희에게 썼노라.
verses.ez: I am writing these things to warn you about those who want to lead you astray.

verses.en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
verses.ko: 너희는 그에게서 받은 기름 부으심이 너희 속에 거하나니, 아무도 너희를 가르칠 필요가 없고 오직 그의 기름 부으심이 너희에게 모든 것을 가르치며 참되고 거짓이 없으니, 그것이 너희를 가르친 그대로 너희가 그 안에 거하라.
verses.ez: But the anointing you received from him remains in you, so you do not need anyone to teach you. His anointing teaches you about everything, and it is true and not a lie. So just as it has taught you, remain in him.

verses.en: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.ko: 이제 어린 자녀들아, 그 안에 거하라. 이는 그가 나타나실 때에 우리로 담대함을 얻어 그의 강림하심 앞에서 부끄럽지 않게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: And now, dear children, remain in him so that when he appears we will be confident and not shrink back in shame at his coming.

verses.en: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
verses.ko: 너희가 그가 의로우신 줄을 알면, 의를 행하는 자마다 그에게서 난 줄을 또한 아느니라.
verses.ez: Since we know that Christ is righteous, we also know that all who do what is right are God's children.

words: to continue in a place or state
life with God that never ends
the Spirit's gift given by God

title: Behold What Manner of Love: We Shall Be Like Him
titleKo: 보라 어떠한 사랑인가 — 우리가 그와 같으리라

verses.en: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.ko: 보라, 아버지께서 우리에게 어떠한 사랑을 베푸셨는가, 우리로 하나님의 자녀라 일컬음을 받게 하셨도다. 세상이 우리를 알지 못함은 그를 알지 못하였음이라.
verses.ez: See how very much our Father loves us, for he calls us his children, and that is what we are! But the people who belong to this world do not recognize us, because they do not know him.

verses.en: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 우리가 지금은 하나님의 자녀라. 장래에 어떻게 될지는 아직 나타나지 아니하였으나, 그가 나타나시면 우리가 그와 같을 줄을 아노니, 이는 그의 참모습 그대로 우리가 그를 볼 것임이라.
verses.ez: Dear friends, we are already God's children, but he has not yet shown us what we will be like when Christ appears. But we do know that we will be like him, for we will see him as he really is.

verses.en: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.ko: 그를 향하여 이 소망을 가진 자마다 그가 깨끗하신 것같이 자기를 깨끗하게 하느니라.
verses.ez: And all who have this eager expectation will keep themselves pure, just as he is pure.

verses.en: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
verses.ko: 죄를 짓는 자마다 또한 율법을 어기나니, 죄는 곧 율법을 어김이라.
verses.ez: Everyone who sins is breaking God's law, for all sin is contrary to the law of God.

verses.en: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
verses.ko: 그가 우리 죄를 없애려고 나타나신 것을 너희가 아나니, 그에게는 죄가 없느니라.
verses.ez: And you know that Jesus came to take away our sins, and there is no sin in him.

verses.en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
verses.ko: 그 안에 거하는 자마다 범죄하지 아니하나니, 범죄하는 자마다 그를 보지도 못하였고 알지도 못하였느니라.
verses.ez: Anyone who continues to live in him will not keep on sinning. But anyone who keeps on sinning does not know him or understand who he is.

verses.en: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.ko: 어린 자녀들아, 아무도 너희를 미혹하지 못하게 하라. 의를 행하는 자는 그가 의로우신 것같이 의로우니라.
verses.ez: Dear children, do not let anyone deceive you about this: When people do what is right, it shows that they are righteous, even as Christ is righteous.

mem.en: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
mem.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 우리가 지금은 하나님의 자녀라. 장래에 어떻게 될지는 아직 나타나지 아니하였으나, 그가 나타나시면 우리가 그와 같을 줄을 아노니, 이는 그의 참모습 그대로 우리가 그를 볼 것임이라.

title: Children of God, Children of the Devil

verses.en: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.ko: 죄를 짓는 자는 마귀에게 속하나니, 이는 마귀가 처음부터 범죄함이라. 하나님의 아들이 나타나신 것은 마귀의 일을 멸하려 하심이라.
verses.ez: But when people keep on sinning, it shows that they belong to the devil, who has been sinning since the beginning. But the Son of God came to destroy the works of the devil.

verses.en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
verses.ko: 하나님께로부터 난 자마다 죄를 짓지 아니하나니, 이는 하나님의 씨가 그 속에 거함이라. 그가 능히 범죄하지 못함은 하나님께로부터 났음이라.
verses.ez: Those who have been born into God's family do not make a practice of sinning, because God's life is in them. So they cannot keep on sinning, because they are children of God.

verses.en: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.ko: 이로써 하나님의 자녀와 마귀의 자녀가 드러나나니, 누구든지 의를 행하지 아니하는 자나 그 형제를 사랑하지 아니하는 자는 하나님께 속하지 아니하니라.
verses.ez: So now we can tell who are children of God and who are children of the devil. Anyone who does not live righteously and does not love other believers does not belong to God.

verses.en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
verses.ko: 우리가 서로 사랑할지니, 이는 너희가 처음부터 들은 소식이라.
verses.ez: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

verses.en: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
verses.ko: 가인같이 하지 말라. 그는 악한 자에게 속하여 그 아우를 죽였으니, 어찌하여 죽였느냐 자기의 행위는 악하고 그 아우의 행위는 의로웠음이라.
verses.ez: We must not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and killed his brother. And why did he kill him? Because Cain had been doing what was evil, and his brother had been doing what was righteous.

verses.en: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
verses.ko: 형제들아, 세상이 너희를 미워하여도 이상히 여기지 말라.
verses.ez: So do not be surprised, dear brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

verses.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
verses.ko: 우리가 형제를 사랑함으로써 사망에서 옮겨 생명으로 들어간 줄을 아노니, 형제를 사랑하지 아니하는 자는 사망 가운데 거하느니라.
verses.ez: If we love our brothers and sisters who are believers, it proves that we have passed from death to life. But a person who has no love is still dead.

title: Love in Deed and in Truth

verses.en: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
verses.ko: 그 형제를 미워하는 자마다 살인하는 자니, 살인하는 자마다 영생이 그 속에 거하지 아니하는 줄을 너희가 아느니라.
verses.ez: Anyone who hates another believer is a murderer, and you know that murderers do not have eternal life within them.

verses.en: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.ko: 그가 우리를 위하여 자기 목숨을 버리셨으니, 이로써 우리가 하나님의 사랑을 알았고 우리도 형제를 위하여 목숨을 버리는 것이 마땅하니라.
verses.ez: We know what real love is because Jesus gave up his life for us. So we also ought to give up our lives for our brothers and sisters.

verses.en: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
verses.ko: 누구든지 이 세상의 재물을 가지고 그 형제의 궁핍함을 보고도 도와줄 마음을 닫으면, 어찌 하나님의 사랑이 그 속에 거하리요.
verses.ez: If someone has enough money to live well and sees a brother or sister in need but shows no compassion — how can God's love be in that person?

verses.en: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
verses.ko: 나의 자녀들아, 우리가 말과 혀로만 사랑하지 말고 행함과 진실함으로 하자.
verses.ez: Dear children, let us not merely say that we love each other; let us show the truth by our actions.

verses.en: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
verses.ko: 이로써 우리가 진리에 속한 줄을 알고 또 그 앞에서 우리 마음을 굳게 하리니,
verses.ez: Our actions will show that we belong to the truth, so we will be confident when we stand before God.

verses.en: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verses.ko: 이는 우리 마음이 우리를 책망할지라도 하나님은 우리 마음보다 크시고 모든 것을 아심이라.
verses.ez: Even if we feel guilty, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.

verses.en: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 우리 마음이 우리를 책망하지 아니하면 우리가 하나님 앞에서 담대함을 얻고,
verses.ez: Dear friends, if we do not feel guilty, we can come to God with bold confidence.

verses.en: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.ko: 무엇이든지 구하는 바를 그에게서 받나니, 이는 우리가 그의 계명을 지키고 그 앞에서 기뻐하시는 것을 행함이라.
verses.ez: And we will receive from him whatever we ask, because we obey him and do the things that please him.

verses.en: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
verses.ko: 그의 계명은 이것이니, 곧 그의 아들 예수 그리스도의 이름을 믿고 그가 우리에게 주신 계명대로 서로 사랑할 것이니라.
verses.ez: And this is his commandment: We must believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he commanded us.

verses.en: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
verses.ko: 그의 계명을 지키는 자는 그 안에 거하고 그도 그 사람 안에 거하시나니, 그가 우리에게 주신 성령으로 말미암아 그가 우리 안에 거하시는 줄을 우리가 아느니라.
verses.ez: Those who obey God's commandments remain in fellowship with him, and he with them. And we know he lives in us because the Spirit he gave us lives in us.

title: Try the Spirits: Greater Is He That Is in You
titleKo: 영들을 분별하라 — 너희 안에 계신 이가 더 크시다

verses.en: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 영을 다 믿지 말고 그 영들이 하나님께 속하였는지 분별하라. 이는 많은 거짓 선지자가 세상에 나왔음이라.
verses.ez: Dear friends, do not believe everyone who claims to speak by the Spirit. Test them to see if the spirit they have comes from God, for there are many false prophets in the world.

verses.en: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
verses.ko: 하나님의 영은 이로써 너희가 알지니, 곧 예수 그리스도께서 육신으로 오신 것을 시인하는 영마다 하나님께 속한 것이요,
verses.ez: This is how you can know if a spirit is from God: If a spirit acknowledges that Jesus Christ came in a real body, that spirit is from God.

verses.en: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
verses.ko: 예수 그리스도께서 육신으로 오신 것을 시인하지 아니하는 영마다 하나님께 속하지 아니한 것이니, 이것이 곧 적그리스도의 영이라. 너희가 그가 오리라 함을 들었거니와 이제 벌써 세상에 있느니라.
verses.ez: But if a spirit does not acknowledge that Jesus came in a real body, that spirit is not from God. Such a spirit is from the antichrist, which you heard is coming and is already in the world.

verses.en: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
verses.ko: 어린 자녀들아, 너희는 하나님께 속하였고 또 그들을 이기었나니, 이는 너희 안에 계신 분이 세상에 있는 자보다 크심이라.
verses.ez: But you belong to God, my dear children. You have already won a victory over those people, because the Spirit who lives in you is greater than the spirit who lives in the world.

verses.en: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
verses.ko: 그들은 세상에 속한 고로 세상에 속한 것을 말하매 세상이 그들의 말을 듣느니라.
verses.ez: Those people belong to this world, so they speak from the world's viewpoint, and the world listens to them.

verses.en: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.ko: 우리는 하나님께 속하였으니, 하나님을 아는 자는 우리의 말을 듣고 하나님께 속하지 아니한 자는 우리의 말을 듣지 아니하나니, 이로써 우리가 진리의 영과 미혹의 영을 아느니라.
verses.ez: But we belong to God, and those who know God listen to us. If they do not belong to God, they do not listen to us. That is how we know if someone has the Spirit of truth or the spirit of deception.

verses.en: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 우리가 서로 사랑하자. 사랑은 하나님께 속한 것이니, 사랑하는 자마다 하나님께로부터 나서 하나님을 아느니라.
verses.ez: Dear friends, let us continue to love one another, for love comes from God. Anyone who loves is a child of God and knows God.

title: God Is Love: He Sent His Only Begotten Son

verses.en: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.ko: 사랑하지 아니하는 자는 하나님을 알지 못하나니, 이는 하나님은 사랑이심이라.
verses.ez: But anyone who does not love does not know God, for God is love.

verses.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
verses.ko: 하나님의 사랑이 우리에게 이렇게 나타난 바 되었으니, 곧 하나님께서 자기의 독생자를 세상에 보내심은 우리로 그로 말미암아 살게 하려 하심이라.
verses.ez: God showed how much he loved us by sending his one and only Son into the world so that we might have eternal life through him.

verses.en: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
verses.ko: 사랑은 여기 있으니, 우리가 하나님을 사랑한 것이 아니요 오직 하나님께서 우리를 사랑하사 우리 죄를 위한 화목제물로 그 아들을 보내신 것이라.
verses.ez: This is real love — not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as a sacrifice to take away our sins.

verses.en: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 하나님께서 이같이 우리를 사랑하셨은즉 우리도 서로 사랑하는 것이 마땅하도다.
verses.ez: Dear friends, since God loved us that much, we surely ought to love each other.

verses.en: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
verses.ko: 어느 때나 하나님을 본 사람이 없으되, 만일 우리가 서로 사랑하면 하나님께서 우리 안에 거하시고 그의 사랑이 우리 안에서 온전하게 되느니라.
verses.ez: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is brought to full expression in us.

verses.en: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
verses.ko: 그가 우리에게 자기의 영을 주셨으므로, 이로써 우리가 그 안에 거하고 그가 우리 안에 거하시는 줄을 아느니라.
verses.ez: And God has given us his Spirit as proof that we live in him and he in us.

verses.en: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
verses.ko: 아버지께서 아들을 세상의 구주로 보내신 것을 우리가 보았고 또 증언하노라.
verses.ez: Furthermore, we have seen with our own eyes and now testify that the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

title: Perfect Love Casts Out Fear

verses.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
verses.ko: 누구든지 예수께서 하나님의 아들이심을 시인하면, 하나님께서 그 안에 거하시고 그도 하나님 안에 거하느니라.
verses.ez: All who confess that Jesus is the Son of God have God living in them, and they live in God.

verses.en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
verses.ko: 하나님께서 우리를 향하여 가지신 사랑을 우리가 알고 또 믿었노니, 하나님은 사랑이시라. 사랑 안에 거하는 자는 하나님 안에 거하고 하나님도 그 안에 거하시느니라.
verses.ez: We know how much God loves us, and we have put our trust in his love. God is love, and all who live in love live in God, and God lives in them.

verses.en: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
verses.ko: 이로써 사랑이 우리에게 온전히 이루어졌은즉, 심판 날에 우리로 담대함을 얻게 하려 하심이니, 이는 그가 그러하신 것같이 우리도 이 세상에서 그러함이라.
verses.ez: And as we live in God, our love grows more perfect. So we will not be afraid on the day of judgment, but we can face him with confidence because we live like Jesus here in this world.

verses.en: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.ko: 사랑 안에는 두려움이 없고 온전한 사랑은 두려움을 내쫓나니, 두려움에는 형벌이 있음이라. 두려워하는 자는 사랑 안에서 온전히 이루어지지 못하였느니라.
verses.ez: Such love has no fear, because perfect love expels all fear. If we are afraid, it is for fear of punishment, and this shows that we have not fully experienced his perfect love.

verses.en: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.ko: 우리가 사랑함은 그가 먼저 우리를 사랑하셨음이라.
verses.ez: We love each other because he loved us first.

verses.en: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
verses.ko: 누가 하나님을 사랑하노라 하면서 그 형제를 미워하면 이는 거짓말하는 자니, 보는 바 그 형제를 사랑하지 아니하는 자가 어찌 보지 못하는 바 하나님을 사랑할 수 있으리요.
verses.ez: If someone says, "I love God," but hates a fellow believer, that person is a liar; for if we do not love people we can see, how can we love God, whom we cannot see?

verses.en: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
verses.ko: 우리가 그에게서 이 계명을 받았나니, 곧 하나님을 사랑하는 자는 또한 그 형제를 사랑할지니라.
verses.ez: And he has given us this command: Those who love God must also love their fellow believers.

words: God's final decision on all people

mem.en: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
mem.ko: 사랑 안에는 두려움이 없고 온전한 사랑은 두려움을 내쫓나니, 두려움에는 형벌이 있음이라. 두려워하는 자는 사랑 안에서 온전히 이루어지지 못하였느니라.
mem.tip: no fear in love → perfect love casts out fear → fear hath torment. 짧은 세 마디가 사슬처럼 이어집니다.
mem.deep: 두려움을 없애는 것은 노력이 아니라 사랑입니다. 사랑을 아는 만큼 형벌의 공포가 자리를 잃습니다.

title: This Is the Victory That Overcometh the World

verses.en: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
verses.ko: 예수께서 그리스도이심을 믿는 자마다 하나님께로부터 난 자니, 또 낳으신 분을 사랑하는 자마다 그에게서 나신 자도 사랑하느니라.
verses.ez: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has become a child of God. And everyone who loves the Father loves his children, too.

verses.en: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
verses.ko: 우리가 하나님을 사랑하고 그의 계명을 지킬 때에, 이로써 우리가 하나님의 자녀를 사랑하는 줄을 아느니라.
verses.ez: We know we love God's children if we love God and obey his commandments.

verses.en: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
verses.ko: 하나님을 사랑하는 것은 이것이니, 곧 그의 계명을 지키는 것이라. 그의 계명은 무거운 것이 아니로다.
verses.ez: Loving God means keeping his commandments, and his commandments are not burdensome.

verses.en: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
verses.ko: 하나님께로부터 난 자마다 세상을 이기느니라. 세상을 이기는 승리는 이것이니, 곧 우리의 믿음이니라.
verses.ez: For every child of God defeats this evil world, and we achieve this victory through our faith.

verses.en: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.ko: 세상을 이기는 자가 누구냐 예수께서 하나님의 아들이심을 믿는 자가 아니냐.
verses.ez: And who can win this battle against the world? Only those who believe that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.en: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
verses.ko: 이분은 물과 피로 임하신 이시니, 곧 예수 그리스도시라. 물로만 아니요 물과 피로 임하셨고, 증언하시는 이는 성령이시니 성령은 진리이심이라.
verses.ez: And Jesus Christ was revealed as God's Son by his baptism in water and by shedding his blood on the cross — not by water only, but by water and blood. And the Spirit, who is truth, confirms it with his testimony.

verses.en: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
verses.ko: 하늘에서 증언하시는 이가 셋이니, 곧 아버지와 말씀과 성령이시라. 이 셋은 하나이시니라.
verses.ez: So there are three witnesses in heaven — the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit — and these three are one.

title: He That Hath the Son Hath Life

verses.en: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
verses.ko: 땅에서 증언하는 것이 셋이니, 곧 성령과 물과 피라. 이 셋은 합하여 하나이니라.
verses.ez: So we have these three witnesses on earth — the Spirit, the water, and the blood — and all three agree.

verses.en: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
verses.ko: 우리가 사람의 증언을 받을진대 하나님의 증언은 더욱 크도다. 하나님의 증언은 이것이니, 곧 그가 자기 아들에 관하여 증언하신 것이라.
verses.ez: Since we believe human testimony, surely we can believe the greater testimony that comes from God. And God has testified about his Son.

verses.en: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
verses.ko: 하나님의 아들을 믿는 자는 자기 안에 그 증언을 가졌고, 하나님을 믿지 아니하는 자는 하나님을 거짓말하는 분으로 만드나니, 이는 하나님께서 그 아들에 관하여 증언하신 것을 믿지 아니하였음이라.
verses.ez: All who believe in the Son of God know in their hearts that this testimony is true. Those who do not believe this are calling God a liar because they do not believe what God has testified about his Son.

verses.en: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.ko: 그 증언은 이것이니, 곧 하나님께서 우리에게 영생을 주신 것이라. 이 생명이 그의 아들 안에 있느니라.
verses.ez: And this is what God has testified: He has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

verses.en: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
verses.ko: 아들을 가진 자에게는 생명이 있고, 하나님의 아들이 없는 자에게는 생명이 없느니라.
verses.ez: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have God's Son does not have life.

verses.en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
verses.ko: 내가 하나님의 아들의 이름을 믿는 너희에게 이것을 쓴 것은, 너희로 영생이 있음을 알게 하고 또 하나님의 아들의 이름을 믿게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: I have written this to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know you have eternal life.

verses.en: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
verses.ko: 우리가 그를 향하여 가진 담대함은 이것이니, 곧 우리가 무엇이든지 그의 뜻을 따라 구하면 그가 우리의 구하는 것을 들으심이라.
verses.ez: And we are confident that he hears us whenever we ask for anything that pleases him.

title: We Know: Born of God, Kept, and True

verses.en: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
verses.ko: 우리가 무엇을 구하든지 그가 들으시는 줄을 알면, 우리가 그에게 구한 그것을 얻은 줄을 또한 아느니라.
verses.ez: And since we know he hears us when we make our requests, we also know that he will give us what we ask for.

verses.en: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
verses.ko: 누구든지 그 형제가 사망에 이르지 아니하는 죄를 범하는 것을 보거든 구하라. 그리하면 사망에 이르지 아니하는 죄를 범하는 자들을 위하여 그가 생명을 주시리라. 사망에 이르는 죄가 있으니, 나는 이것을 위하여 구하라 하지 아니하노라.
verses.ez: If you see a fellow believer sinning in a way that does not lead to death, you should pray, and God will give that person life. But there is a sin that leads to death, and I am not saying you should pray for it.

verses.en: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
verses.ko: 모든 불의가 죄로되, 사망에 이르지 아니하는 죄도 있느니라.
verses.ez: All wicked actions are sin, but not every sin leads to death.

verses.en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
verses.ko: 하나님께로부터 난 자마다 범죄하지 아니하는 줄을 우리가 아노니, 하나님께로부터 나신 이가 그를 지키시매 악한 자가 그를 만지지도 못하느니라.
verses.ez: We know that God's children do not make a practice of sinning, for God's Son holds them securely, and the evil one cannot touch them.

verses.en: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
verses.ko: 우리는 하나님께 속한 줄을 알고, 온 세상은 악한 자 안에 놓여 있는 줄을 아노라.
verses.ez: We know that we are children of God and that the world around us is under the control of the evil one.

verses.en: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
verses.ko: 또 우리가 아노니, 하나님의 아들이 오셔서 우리에게 지각을 주사 참되신 분을 알게 하셨고, 우리는 참되신 분 곧 그의 아들 예수 그리스도 안에 있느니라. 이분은 참 하나님이시요 영생이시니라.
verses.ez: And we know that the Son of God has come, and he has given us understanding so that we can know the true God. And now we live in fellowship with the true God because we live in fellowship with his Son, Jesus Christ. He is the only true God, and he is eternal life.

title: Walking in Truth and Love

verses.en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verses.ko: 장로는 택하심을 받은 부녀와 그 자녀들에게 쓰노니, 내가 진리 안에서 너희를 사랑하노라. 나뿐 아니라 진리를 아는 모든 이도 그러하니,
verses.ez: This letter is from the elder to the chosen lady and her children. I love you in the truth — and so does everyone else who knows the truth.

verses.en: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
verses.ko: 이는 우리 안에 거하여 영원히 우리와 함께 있을 진리를 인함이라.
verses.ez: We love you because of the truth that lives in us and will be with us forever.

verses.en: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.ko: 아버지 하나님과 또 아버지의 아들이신 주 예수 그리스도께로부터 은혜와 긍휼과 평강이 진리와 사랑 안에서 너희와 함께 있으리라.
verses.ez: May grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, be with us who live in truth and love.

verses.en: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
verses.ko: 네 자녀들 중에 우리가 아버지께 받은 계명대로 진리 안에서 행하는 자를 내가 보고 심히 기뻐하였노라.
verses.ez: I was very happy to find some of your children living by the truth, just as the Father commanded us.

verses.en: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.ko: 부녀여, 이제 내가 네게 구하노니, 이는 새 계명을 쓰는 것이 아니요 우리가 처음부터 가진 것이라, 곧 우리가 서로 사랑하자는 것이라.
verses.ez: And now, dear lady, I ask you this: let us love one another. This is not a new command; we have had it from the beginning.

verses.en: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
verses.ko: 사랑은 이것이니, 곧 우리가 그의 계명을 따라 행하는 것이라. 계명은 이것이니, 너희가 처음부터 들은 대로 그 안에서 행하라는 것이라.
verses.ez: Love means doing what God has commanded us. And he has commanded, as you heard from the beginning, that you must live in love.

verses.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.ko: 이는 미혹하는 자가 많이 세상에 들어왔음이니, 곧 예수 그리스도께서 육신으로 오신 것을 시인하지 아니하는 자라. 이러한 자가 곧 미혹하는 자요 적그리스도라.
verses.ez: Many deceivers have gone out into the world. They deny that Jesus Christ came in a real body. Such a person is a deceiver and an antichrist.

title: Look to Yourselves: Abide in the Doctrine

verses.en: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
verses.ko: 너희는 스스로 삼가 우리가 일한 것을 잃지 말고 온전한 상을 받으라.
verses.ez: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but receive a full reward.

verses.en: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
verses.ko: 누구든지 지나쳐서 그리스도의 교훈 안에 거하지 아니하는 자는 하나님을 모시지 못하되, 그리스도의 교훈 안에 거하는 자는 아버지와 아들을 모두 모시느니라.
verses.ez: Anyone who goes beyond the teaching of Christ and does not remain in it does not have God. But whoever remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

verses.en: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
verses.ko: 누가 너희에게 나아와 이 교훈을 가지지 아니하거든 그를 집에 들이지도 말고 인사도 하지 말라.
verses.ez: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not welcome that person into your home or give any greeting of support.

verses.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
verses.ko: 그에게 인사하는 자는 그 악한 일에 참여하는 자임이라.
verses.ez: Anyone who greets such a person that way shares in the evil work being done.

verses.en: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
verses.ko: 내가 너희에게 쓸 것이 많으나 종이와 먹으로 쓰기를 원치 아니하고, 도리어 너희에게 나아가 얼굴을 마주하여 말하기를 바라노니, 이는 우리의 기쁨을 충만하게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: I have much more to say to you, but I do not want to do it with paper and ink. I hope to visit you and talk with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

verses.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
verses.ko: 택하심을 받은 네 자매의 자녀들이 네게 문안하느니라. 아멘.
verses.ez: The children of your chosen sister send you their greetings. Amen.

mem.tip: transgresseth(지나쳐서) ↔ abideth(거하여). 앞뒤 절이 정확히 뒤집힌 대구입니다.
mem.deep: transgress의 본뜻은 '선을 넘어가다'입니다. 뒤처지는 것이 아니라 앞서 나가다 벗어나는 것을 경계합니다.

spoon: 12절이 따뜻합니다. 편지로 다 못 할 말이 있어서 만나러 가겠다고 합니다. 글보다 얼굴이 먼저입니다.

title: That Thy Soul Prospereth

verses.en: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
verses.ko: 장로는 사랑하는 가이오에게 쓰노니, 내가 진리 안에서 너를 사랑하노라.
verses.ez: This letter is from the elder to my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

verses.en: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자여, 네 영혼이 잘됨같이 네가 범사에 잘되고 강건하기를 내가 무엇보다 간구하노라.
verses.ez: Dear friend, I pray above all else that all may go well with you and that you may be in good health, just as your soul is doing well.

verses.en: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
verses.ko: 형제들이 와서 네 안에 있는 진리를 증언하되, 네가 진리 안에서 행함을 증언하매 내가 심히 기뻐하였노라.
verses.ez: I was very happy when some believers came and told me about the truth in you and how you are living by that truth.

verses.en: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
verses.ko: 내 자녀들이 진리 안에서 행한다 함을 듣는 것보다 내게 더 큰 기쁨이 없도다.
verses.ez: I could have no greater joy than to hear that my children are living by the truth.

verses.en: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자여, 네가 형제 곧 나그네 된 자들에게 무엇을 행하든지 신실하게 행하니,
verses.ez: Dear friend, you are being faithful in everything you do for the believers, even those you have never met.

verses.en: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
verses.ko: 그들이 교회 앞에서 네 사랑을 증언하였느니라. 네가 하나님께 합당하게 그들을 그 여행길에 잘 보내면 잘하는 것이라.
verses.ez: They have told the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner that honors God.

verses.en: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.ko: 이는 그들이 그 이름을 위하여 나갔으나 이방인에게서는 아무것도 받지 아니함이라.
verses.ez: For they are traveling for the sake of his name, and they accept nothing from those who are not believers.

title: Follow Not That Which Is Evil

verses.en: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
verses.ko: 그러므로 우리가 이러한 자들을 영접하는 것이 마땅하니, 이는 우리로 진리를 위하여 함께 일하는 자가 되게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: So we ought to support such people, so that we may work together for the truth.

verses.en: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.ko: 내가 교회에 두어 자 썼으나, 그들 가운데 으뜸 되기를 좋아하는 디오드레베가 우리를 영접하지 아니하니,
verses.ez: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, refuses to welcome us.

verses.en: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
verses.ko: 그러므로 내가 가면 그가 행하는 일을 들추어내리라. 그는 악한 말로 우리를 비방하고도 만족하지 아니하여, 친히 형제들을 영접하지도 아니하고 영접하고자 하는 자들도 금하여 교회에서 내쫓는도다.
verses.ez: So when I come, I will bring up what he is doing — spreading false and spiteful talk about us. And that is not enough for him: he refuses to welcome the believers, stops those who want to, and puts them out of the church.

verses.en: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자여, 악한 것을 본받지 말고 선한 것을 본받으라. 선을 행하는 자는 하나님께 속하고, 악을 행하는 자는 하나님을 뵙지 못하였느니라.
verses.ez: Dear friend, do not copy what is evil, but what is good. Anyone who does good belongs to God; anyone who does evil has not seen God.

verses.en: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
verses.ko: 데메드리오는 뭇사람에게도 또 진리 자체에게도 좋은 증언을 받았으니, 우리도 증언하노라. 너희는 우리의 증언이 참된 줄을 아느니라.
verses.ez: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the truth itself. We speak well of him too, and you know that what we say is true.

verses.en: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
verses.ko: 내가 네게 쓸 것이 많으나 먹과 붓으로 쓰기를 원치 아니하고,
verses.ez: I have much more to say to you, but I do not want to write it with pen and ink.

verses.en: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
verses.ko: 속히 너를 보기를 바라노니, 그때에 얼굴을 마주하여 말하리라. 평강이 네게 있을지어다. 친구들이 네게 문안하느니라. 너는 친구들에게 일일이 이름을 불러 문안하라.
verses.ez: I hope to see you soon, and then we will talk face to face. Peace be with you. Your friends here send their greetings. Please greet each of the friends there by name.

title: Earnestly Contend for the Faith

verses.en: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
verses.ko: 예수 그리스도의 종이요 야고보의 형제인 유다는 하나님 아버지 안에서 거룩하게 하심을 받고 예수 그리스도 안에서 보전되어 부르심을 입은 이들에게 편지하노라.
verses.ez: This letter is from Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James. I am writing to those who are called, made holy by God the Father, and kept safe in Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
verses.ko: 긍휼과 평강과 사랑이 너희에게 더욱 많을지어다.
verses.ez: May mercy, peace, and love be given to you more and more.

verses.en: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 내가 우리가 함께 받은 구원에 관하여 너희에게 쓰려고 온 힘을 다하던 차에, 성도에게 단번에 주신 믿음의 도를 위하여 힘써 싸우라고 너희에게 권하여 쓰는 것이 부득이하게 되었노라.
verses.ez: Dear friends, I was working hard to write to you about the salvation we share, but I found I had to write and urge you to fight hard for the faith that God gave his holy people once for all.

verses.en: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.ko: 이는 가만히 들어온 어떤 사람들이 있음이니, 그들은 옛적부터 이 정죄에 미리 기록된 자들이라. 경건치 아니하여 우리 하나님의 은혜를 방탕으로 바꾸고 홀로 주재이신 주 곧 우리 주 예수 그리스도를 부인하는 자들이니라.
verses.ez: For certain people have slipped in among you without being noticed. Long ago they were marked out for this judgment. They are ungodly people who twist God's grace into a license for sin and who deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

verses.en: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
verses.ko: 너희가 본래 이 모든 것을 알았으나, 내가 너희에게 다시 생각나게 하고자 하노니, 곧 주께서 백성을 애굽 땅에서 구원하여 내시고 후에 믿지 아니하는 자들을 멸하셨으며,
verses.ez: So I want to remind you, though you already know it, that the Lord rescued the people out of Egypt but later destroyed those who did not believe.

verses.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
verses.ko: 또 자기 지위를 지키지 아니하고 자기 처소를 떠난 천사들을 큰 날의 심판까지 영원한 결박으로 흑암 가운데 가두어 두셨느니라.
verses.ez: And he has kept the angels who did not stay within their proper place but left their own home. He holds them in everlasting chains under darkness until the judgment of that great day.
