title: Set Forth for an Example

verses.en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
verses.ko: 이와 같이 소돔과 고모라와 그 주변 도시들도 그들처럼 음란하며 다른 육체를 따라가다가, 영원한 불의 형벌을 받아 본보기가 되었느니라.
verses.ez: In the same way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns around them gave themselves over to sexual sin and went after what was not theirs. They stand as an example of those who suffer the punishment of eternal fire.

verses.en: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
verses.ko: 그럼에도 이 더러운 꿈꾸는 자들도 이와 같이 육체를 더럽히며 권위를 멸시하며 영광 있는 자들을 비방하는도다.
verses.ez: In the same way, these dreamers make their bodies unclean, reject authority, and speak against beings of glory.

verses.en: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
verses.ko: 천사장 미가엘이 모세의 시체에 관하여 마귀와 다투어 변론할 때에도, 감히 모욕하는 판단으로 그를 정죄하지 못하고 다만 "주께서 너를 꾸짖으시기를 원하노라" 하였거늘,
verses.ez: But even Michael, one of the mightiest of the angels, did not dare to bring an insulting charge against the devil when they argued about the body of Moses. He only said, "May the Lord rebuke you."

verses.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
verses.ko: 이 사람들은 알지 못하는 것을 비방하며, 이성 없는 짐승같이 본능으로 아는 그것으로 스스로 멸망하는도다.
verses.ez: But these people speak against things they do not understand. And what they do know by instinct, like unthinking animals, is the very thing that destroys them.

verses.en: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
verses.ko: 그들에게 화가 있을진저! 이는 그들이 가인의 길로 행하였고, 삯을 위하여 발람의 어그러진 길로 몰려갔으며, 고라의 패역으로 멸망하였음이라.
verses.ez: How terrible for them! They follow the path of Cain, they rush after money the way Balaam did, and they are destroyed in rebellion like Korah.

verses.en: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
verses.ko: 이들은 너희의 애찬에 함께 먹으면서도 두려움 없이 자기 몸만 기르는 암초요, 바람에 밀려가는 물 없는 구름이요, 열매 없이 시들고 뿌리째 뽑혀 두 번 죽은 나무요,
verses.ez: They are hidden rocks at your love feasts, eating with you while caring only for themselves. They are clouds with no rain, blown along by the wind; trees without fruit at harvest, twice dead and pulled up by the roots.

verses.en: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
verses.ko: 자기 부끄러움의 거품을 뿜어내는 바다의 거친 물결이요, 영원토록 캄캄한 흑암이 예비된 떠도는 별들이라.
verses.ez: They are wild waves of the sea, throwing up the foam of their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the deepest darkness has been kept forever.

title: Behold, the Lord Cometh

verses.en: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
verses.ko: 아담의 칠대손 에녹도 이 사람들에 관하여 예언하여 이르되 "보라, 주께서 그 수만의 거룩한 자들과 함께 임하셨으니,
verses.ez: Enoch, who lived seven generations after Adam, spoke about these people long ago: "Look, the Lord is coming with countless thousands of his holy ones,

verses.en: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
verses.ko: 이는 모든 사람을 심판하시며, 그들 가운데 모든 경건치 아니한 자들이 경건치 않게 행한 모든 경건치 아니한 일과, 경건치 아니한 죄인들이 주를 거슬러 말한 모든 강퍅한 말로 인하여 그들을 정죄하려 하심이라" 하였느니라.
verses.ez: to judge everyone and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly thing they have done and of every harsh word that ungodly sinners have spoken against him."

verses.en: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.
verses.ko: 이 사람들은 원망하는 자요 불평하는 자며 자기 정욕을 따라 행하는 자니, 그 입으로 자랑하는 큰 말을 내며 이익을 위하여 사람을 떠받드는 자들이라.
verses.ez: These people grumble and find fault; they follow their own desires. They boast loudly about themselves and flatter others to get what they want.

verses.en: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 너희는 우리 주 예수 그리스도의 사도들이 미리 한 말을 기억하라.
verses.ez: But dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ said beforehand.

verses.en: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
verses.ko: 그들이 너희에게 말하기를 "마지막 때에 자기의 경건치 아니한 정욕을 따라 행하는 조롱하는 자들이 있으리라" 하였느니라.
verses.ez: They told you that in the last days there would be scoffers who follow their own ungodly desires.

verses.en: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
verses.ko: 이들은 분열을 일으키는 자요 육에 속한 자며 성령이 없는 자들이라.
verses.ez: These are the people who cause divisions. They follow their natural instincts and do not have the Spirit.

title: Able to Keep You from Falling

verses.en: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
verses.ko: 그러나 사랑하는 자들아, 너희는 너희의 지극히 거룩한 믿음 위에 자신을 세우며 성령으로 기도하고,
verses.ez: But you, dear friends, must build yourselves up on your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
verses.ko: 하나님의 사랑 안에서 너희 자신을 지키며 영생에 이르도록 우리 주 예수 그리스도의 긍휼을 기다리라.
verses.ez: Keep yourselves in God's love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, which brings eternal life.

verses.en: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
verses.ko: 어떤 의심하는 자들을 긍휼히 여기고,
verses.ez: Show mercy to those who are wavering, treating each case as it needs.

verses.en: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
verses.ko: 또 어떤 자들은 불에서 끌어내어 두려움으로 구원하되, 육체로 더럽혀진 옷까지도 미워하라.
verses.ez: Save others by snatching them out of the fire. Show mercy to still others, but with great care, hating even the clothing stained by their sin.

verses.en: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
verses.ko: 능히 너희를 실족하지 않게 지키시고 그 영광 앞에 흠 없이 큰 기쁨으로 세우실 이,
verses.ez: Now all glory to God, who is able to keep you from falling away and to bring you into his glorious presence without fault and with great joy.

verses.en: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
verses.ko: 곧 우리 구주이신 홀로 지혜로우신 하나님께 우리 주 예수 그리스도로 말미암아 영광과 위엄과 권세와 능력이 이제와 영원토록 있을지어다. 아멘.
verses.ez: To the only wise God our Savior be glory, majesty, power, and authority, both now and forever. Amen.

title: God Hath Spoken unto Us by His Son

verses.en: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
verses.ko: 하나님께서 옛적에 여러 부분과 여러 모양으로 선지자들을 통하여 조상들에게 말씀하시던 그 하나님이,
verses.ez: Long ago God spoke to our ancestors many times and in many ways through the prophets.

verses.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
verses.ko: 이 마지막 날에는 아들을 통하여 우리에게 말씀하셨으니, 그를 만유의 상속자로 세우시고 또한 그로 말미암아 모든 세계를 지으셨느니라.
verses.ez: But now in these final days he has spoken to us through his Son. God promised everything to the Son as an inheritance, and through the Son he made the universe.

verses.en: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
verses.ko: 그는 하나님의 영광의 광채시요 그 본체의 형상이시라, 그의 능력의 말씀으로 만물을 붙드시며 친히 우리의 죄를 깨끗하게 하신 후에 높은 곳에 계신 위엄의 우편에 앉으셨으니,
verses.ez: The Son shines out with God's glory and is the exact likeness of God's own being. He holds everything together by his powerful word. After he had cleansed us from our sins, he sat down at the right hand of the majestic God in heaven.

verses.en: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.ko: 천사들보다 훨씬 뛰어나심은 그가 그들보다 더욱 탁월한 이름을 기업으로 받으심이라.
verses.ez: This shows that the Son is far greater than the angels, just as the name God gave him is greater than their names.

verses.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
verses.ko: 하나님께서 어느 천사에게 일찍이 이르시기를 "너는 내 아들이라, 오늘 내가 너를 낳았도다" 하셨으며, 또다시 "나는 그에게 아버지가 되고 그는 내게 아들이 되리라" 하셨느냐?
verses.ez: For God never said to any angel what he said to Jesus: "You are my Son. Today I have become your Father." God also said, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son."

verses.en: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
verses.ko: 또 그 맏아들을 세상에 다시 이끌어 들이실 때에 이르시되 "하나님의 모든 천사들은 그에게 경배할지어다" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: And when he brought his firstborn Son into the world, God said, "Let all of God's angels worship him."

verses.en: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
verses.ko: 천사들에 관하여는 이르시되 "그가 자기 천사들을 바람으로 삼으시며 자기 사역자들을 불꽃으로 삼으시느니라" 하셨으되,
verses.ez: Regarding the angels, he says, "He sends his angels like the winds, his servants like flames of fire."

title: Thy Throne, O God, Is for Ever

verses.en: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.ko: 아들에 관하여는 이르시되 "오 하나님이여, 주의 보좌는 영원무궁하며 주의 왕국의 규는 의로운 규로소이다.
verses.ez: But to the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, lasts for ever and ever. You rule your kingdom with a scepter of justice."

verses.en: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.ko: 주께서 의를 사랑하시고 불법을 미워하셨으니, 그러므로 하나님 곧 주의 하나님께서 즐거움의 기름을 주께 부어 주의 동류들보다 뛰어나게 하셨도다" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: "You have loved what is right and hated what is wrong. Therefore, O God, your God has poured out the oil of joy on you more than on anyone else."

verses.en: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
verses.ko: 또 이르시되 "오 주여, 주께서 태초에 땅의 기초를 놓으셨으며 하늘들도 주의 손으로 지으신 것이라.
verses.ez: He also says, "In the beginning, Lord, you laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands."

verses.en: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.ko: 그것들은 멸망하려니와 주는 영존하시겠고, 그것들은 다 옷과 같이 낡아지리니,
verses.ez: "They will perish, but you remain for ever. They will all wear out like an old piece of clothing."

verses.en: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
verses.ko: 주께서 그것들을 겉옷처럼 말아 두시매 그것들이 변하려니와, 주는 한결같으시고 주의 연대는 다함이 없으리이다" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: "You will fold them up like a coat, and they will be changed. But you are always the same; your years never end."

verses.en: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.ko: 또 어느 천사에게 일찍이 이르시기를 "내가 네 원수들을 네 발판이 되게 하기까지 너는 내 우편에 앉아 있으라" 하셨느냐?
verses.ez: And God never said to any of the angels, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool under your feet."

verses.en: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
verses.ko: 천사들은 다 섬기는 영들로서, 구원을 상속받을 자들을 위하여 섬기라고 보내심을 받은 자들이 아니냐?
verses.ez: Are not the angels only servants — spirits sent out to care for those who will receive salvation?

title: How Shall We Escape, If We Neglect So Great Salvation

verses.en: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
verses.ko: 그러므로 우리가 들은 것들에 더욱 간절히 주의를 기울여야 하리니, 어느 때에라도 그것들을 흘려버리지 않게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: So we must pay much closer attention to what we have heard, or we may drift away from it.

verses.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.ko: 천사들을 통하여 이르신 말씀이 굳건하여 모든 범법과 불순종이 공정한 보응을 받았거든,
verses.ez: For the message God delivered through angels stood firm, and every violation and act of disobedience received its just punishment.

verses.en: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
verses.ko: 우리가 이같이 큰 구원을 소홀히 여기면 어찌 피하리요? 이 구원은 처음에 주께서 친히 말씀하시기 시작하셨고 그를 들은 자들이 우리에게 확증한 것이며,
verses.ez: So how shall we escape if we ignore such a great salvation? It was first announced by the Lord himself, and it was confirmed to us by those who heard him.

verses.en: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
verses.ko: 하나님께서도 표적들과 기사들과 여러 능력과 또 자기 뜻을 따라 나누어 주신 성령의 은사들로 그들과 더불어 증언하셨느니라.
verses.ez: And God confirmed their message by signs and wonders, various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, given according to his will.

verses.en: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.ko: 하나님께서 우리가 말하는 바 장차 올 세상을 천사들에게 복종하게 하신 것이 아니니라.
verses.ez: For it is not to angels that God has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.

verses.en: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.ko: 오직 어떤 이가 어느 곳에서 증언하여 이르되 "사람이 무엇이기에 주께서 그를 기억하시며, 인자가 무엇이기에 주께서 그를 돌보시나이까?
verses.ez: But somewhere in the Scriptures someone testified, "What is man that you think of him, or the son of man that you care for him?"

title: But We See Jesus, Crowned with Glory

verses.en: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
verses.ko: 주께서 그를 천사들보다 잠깐 못하게 하셨다가 영광과 존귀로 그에게 관을 씌우시고 주의 손으로 지으신 것들을 다스리게 하셨으며,
verses.ez: "You made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honor and set him over the works of your hands."

verses.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.ko: 만물을 그의 발 아래 복종하게 하셨나이다" 하였으니, 그가 만물을 그에게 복종하게 하셨은즉 복종하지 않은 것이 하나도 없게 하셨느니라. 그러나 우리가 아직은 만물이 그에게 복종한 것을 보지 못하거니와,
verses.ez: "You put all things under his authority." When God put all things under him, he left nothing outside his rule. Yet we do not yet see all things under his authority.

verses.en: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
verses.ko: 오직 우리가 보는 것은, 천사들보다 잠깐 못하게 되셨던 예수께서 죽음의 고난을 받으심으로 인하여 영광과 존귀로 관을 쓰셨으니, 이는 하나님의 은혜로 모든 사람을 위하여 죽음을 맛보려 하심이라.
verses.ez: But we do see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels. Because he suffered death, he is now crowned with glory and honor — so that by God's grace he might taste death for everyone.

verses.en: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.ko: 만물이 그를 위하여 있고 또한 그로 말미암아 있는 그분께서, 많은 아들들을 영광으로 이끄심에 그들의 구원의 창시자를 고난을 통하여 온전하게 하심이 합당하였느니라.
verses.ez: It was fitting that God — for whom and through whom everything exists — in bringing many sons to glory, should make the founder of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

verses.en: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.ko: 거룩하게 하시는 이와 거룩하게 함을 받는 자들이 다 하나에게서 났으니, 그러므로 그가 그들을 형제라 부르심을 부끄러워하지 아니하시고,
verses.ez: Both the one who makes people holy and those who are made holy are of the same family. That is why he is not ashamed to call them brothers.

verses.en: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.ko: 이르시되 "내가 주의 이름을 내 형제들에게 선포하고 회중 가운데서 주를 찬송하리이다" 하셨으며,
verses.ez: He says, "I will declare your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will sing your praise."

title: Partakers of Flesh and Blood

verses.en: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
verses.ko: 또 이르시되 "내가 그를 의지하리라" 하셨고, 또 "보라, 나와 및 하나님께서 내게 주신 자녀들이라" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: He also says, "I will put my trust in him," and again, "Here am I, and the children God has given me."

verses.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.ko: 그런즉 자녀들은 혈과 육에 속하였으매 그도 친히 그와 같이 혈과 육을 함께 지니셨으니, 이는 죽음을 통하여 죽음의 권세를 잡은 자 곧 마귀를 멸하시고,
verses.ez: Because God's children are human beings of flesh and blood, Jesus also became flesh and blood like them. For only as a human being could he die, and only by dying could he destroy the devil, who had the power of death.

verses.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.ko: 또 죽음의 두려움으로 인하여 일평생 종노릇 하던 모든 자들을 놓아 주려 하심이라.
verses.ez: Only in this way could he set free all who have lived their lives as slaves to the fear of dying.

verses.en: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
verses.ko: 진실로 그가 천사들의 본성을 취하신 것이 아니요 아브라함의 씨를 취하셨느니라.
verses.ez: For truly he did not come to help angels; he came to help the descendants of Abraham.

verses.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
verses.ko: 그러므로 그가 모든 일에 형제들과 같이 되심이 마땅하였으니, 이는 하나님께 속한 일에 백성의 죄를 속하기 위한 자비롭고 신실한 대제사장이 되려 하심이라.
verses.ez: Therefore it was necessary for him to be made like his brothers in every way, so that he could be a merciful and faithful high priest before God, and make atonement for the sins of the people.

verses.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
verses.ko: 그가 친히 시험을 받아 고난을 당하셨은즉 시험받는 자들을 능히 도우실 수 있느니라.
verses.ez: Since he himself has gone through suffering and testing, he is able to help those who are being tested.

title: Consider Christ Jesus: A Son over His Own House
titleKo: 그리스도 예수를 깊이 생각하라 — 아들로서 자기 집을

verses.en: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
verses.ko: 그러므로 하늘의 부르심에 참여한 거룩한 형제들아, 우리가 고백하는 사도시요 대제사장이신 그리스도 예수를 깊이 생각하라.
verses.ez: So, dear holy brothers who share in the heavenly calling, fix your thoughts on Jesus, the Apostle and High Priest whom we confess.

verses.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
verses.ko: 그는 자기를 세우신 이에게 신실하셨으니, 모세가 하나님의 온 집에서 신실하였던 것과 같으니라.
verses.ez: He was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God's house.

verses.en: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.ko: 이분은 모세보다 더욱 큰 영광을 받기에 합당하다 여김을 받으셨으니, 이는 집을 지은 자가 그 집보다 더 큰 존귀를 받음이라.
verses.ez: But Jesus was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has more honor than the house itself.

verses.en: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
verses.ko: 집마다 누군가에 의하여 지어지거니와 만물을 지으신 이는 하나님이시니라.
verses.ez: For every house is built by someone, but the builder of everything is God.

verses.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.ko: 과연 모세는 하나님의 온 집에서 종으로서 신실하였으니, 이는 장차 이르실 것들을 증언하기 위함이요,
verses.ez: Moses was indeed faithful in all God's house, but only as a servant, bearing witness to what would be spoken later.

verses.en: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.ko: 그리스도는 아들로서 자기 집을 다스리시느니라. 우리가 그 소망의 담대함과 자랑을 끝까지 굳게 붙들면 우리가 곧 그의 집이니라.
verses.ez: But Christ is faithful as a Son over God's house. And we are his house, if we hold on to our courage and the hope in which we rejoice, firm to the end.

words: all the way to the finish

title: To Day If Ye Will Hear His Voice

verses.en: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.ko: 그러므로 성령께서 이르신 바와 같으니라. "오늘 너희가 그의 음성을 듣거든,
verses.ez: So, as the Holy Spirit says, "Today, if you hear his voice,

verses.en: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.ko: 광야에서 시험하던 날 격노하게 하던 때처럼 너희 마음을 완고하게 하지 말라.
verses.ez: do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion, on the day of testing in the wilderness.

verses.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.ko: 거기서 너희 조상들이 나를 시험하여 나를 증험하고 사십 년 동안 내 행사를 보았느니라.
verses.ez: There your ancestors tested me and tried me, though they saw my works for forty years.

verses.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.ko: 그러므로 내가 그 세대에게 노하여 이르기를 '그들이 항상 마음으로 미혹되어 내 길을 알지 못하였도다' 하였고,
verses.ez: That is why I was angry with that generation and said, 'Their hearts always go astray, and they have not known my ways.'

verses.en: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
verses.ko: 내가 진노하여 맹세한 바 '그들은 내 안식에 들어오지 못하리라' 하였노라" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: So I swore in my anger, 'They shall never enter my rest.'"

verses.en: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
verses.ko: 형제들아, 너희 가운데 누구라도 믿지 않는 악한 마음을 품어 살아 계신 하나님에게서 떠나지 않도록 삼가라.
verses.ez: Be careful, brothers, that none of you has an evil, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.

verses.en: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.ko: 오직 오늘이라 일컫는 동안에 날마다 서로 권면하여, 너희 가운데 누구도 죄의 속임수로 인하여 완고하게 되지 않게 하라.
verses.ez: Instead, encourage one another daily, as long as it is called "Today," so that none of you may be hardened by sin's deceitfulness.

title: They Could Not Enter In Because of Unbelief

verses.en: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.ko: 우리가 처음 확신한 것을 끝까지 굳게 붙들면 그리스도에게 참여한 자가 되리라.
verses.ez: For we share in Christ, if we hold our original confidence firm to the end.

verses.en: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.ko: 이르신 바 "오늘 너희가 그의 음성을 듣거든 격노하게 하던 때처럼 너희 마음을 완고하게 하지 말라" 하셨으니,
verses.ez: As it has been said, "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as in the rebellion."

verses.en: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.ko: 들은 자들 가운데 격노하게 한 자가 누구냐? 모세를 따라 애굽에서 나온 모든 자가 아니냐?
verses.ez: Who were they who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

verses.en: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.ko: 또 하나님께서 사십 년 동안 누구에게 노하셨느냐? 범죄하여 그 시체가 광야에 쓰러진 자들에게가 아니냐?
verses.ez: And with whom was God angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

verses.en: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.ko: 또 누구에게 그들이 자기 안식에 들어오지 못하리라 맹세하셨느냐? 곧 순종하지 아니한 자들에게가 아니냐?
verses.ez: And to whom did God swear that they would never enter his rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?

verses.en: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.ko: 이로 보건대 그들이 능히 들어가지 못한 것은 믿지 아니함으로 인함이었느니라.
verses.ez: So we see that they were not able to enter, because of their unbelief.

title: A Promise of Entering into His Rest

verses.en: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.ko: 그러므로 그의 안식에 들어가리라는 약속이 우리에게 남아 있은즉, 우리는 두려워할지니 너희 가운데 누구라도 거기에 미치지 못하는 자가 있을까 함이라.
verses.ez: Therefore, since the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you should seem to have fallen short of it.

verses.en: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
verses.ko: 우리에게도 복음이 전하여진 것이 그들에게와 같으나, 들은 자들에게 들은 말씀이 믿음과 결합되지 못하였으므로 그들에게 유익이 되지 못하였느니라.
verses.ez: For the good news was preached to us just as to them. But the message they heard did them no good, because it was not combined with faith in those who heard it.

verses.en: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.ko: 이미 믿은 우리는 그 안식에 들어가거니와, 이는 그가 이르신 바 "내가 진노하여 맹세한 대로 그들은 내 안식에 들어오지 못하리라" 하심과 같으니, 그러나 그의 일들은 세상의 기초가 놓일 때부터 이미 마쳐졌느니라.
verses.ez: Now we who have believed do enter that rest, just as he said, "So I swore in my anger, they shall never enter my rest" — although his works were finished from the foundation of the world.

verses.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.ko: 그가 어느 곳에서 일곱째 날에 관하여 이같이 이르시되 "하나님께서 일곱째 날에 그 모든 일을 마치고 안식하셨느니라" 하셨으며,
verses.ez: For somewhere he has spoken about the seventh day in these words: "On the seventh day God rested from all his works."

verses.en: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.ko: 또 이곳에서 다시 "그들은 내 안식에 들어오지 못하리라" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: And again in this passage he says, "They shall never enter my rest."

title: There Remaineth a Rest to the People of God

verses.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
verses.ko: 그러므로 어떤 이들이 거기에 들어갈 일이 남아 있고, 먼저 복음을 들은 자들은 믿지 아니함으로 인하여 들어가지 못하였은즉,
verses.ez: Since therefore it remains for some to enter it, and those who formerly received the good news failed to enter because of unbelief,

verses.en: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.ko: 오랜 후에 다윗을 통하여 다시 어느 날을 정하여 이르시되 "오늘 너희가 그의 음성을 듣거든 너희 마음을 완고하게 하지 말라" 하셨으니, 이는 위에서 말한 바와 같으니라.
verses.ez: God again set a certain day, calling it "Today," when a long time later he spoke through David, as was said before: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts."

verses.en: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.ko: 만일 여호수아가 그들에게 안식을 주었더라면 그 후에 다른 날을 말씀하지 아니하셨으리라.
verses.ez: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.

verses.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
verses.ko: 그런즉 하나님의 백성에게는 안식할 안식이 남아 있도다.
verses.ez: So there remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

verses.en: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
verses.ko: 이는 그의 안식에 들어간 자는 하나님께서 자기 일을 그치심같이 자기 일을 그쳤음이라.
verses.ez: For whoever has entered God's rest has also rested from his own works, just as God rested from his.

verses.en: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
verses.ko: 그러므로 우리가 그 안식에 들어가기를 힘쓸지니, 누구라도 그와 같은 불순종의 본을 따라 넘어지지 않게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: Let us therefore make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one may fall by following the same example of unbelief.

title: The Word of God Is Quick, and Powerful
titleKo: 하나님의 말씀은 살아 있고 활력이 있어

verses.en: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.ko: 하나님의 말씀은 살아 있고 활력이 있어 좌우에 날선 어떤 검보다도 예리하여, 혼과 영과 및 관절과 골수를 찔러 쪼개기까지 하며 마음의 생각과 뜻을 분별하느니라.
verses.ez: For the word of God is alive and active, sharper than any two-edged sword. It cuts deep enough to divide soul and spirit, joints and marrow, and it judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

verses.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.ko: 또한 그분 앞에 드러나지 않는 피조물이 하나도 없으니, 우리가 상관하는 그분의 눈앞에는 만물이 벌거벗은 것같이 드러나느니라.
verses.ez: Nothing in all creation is hidden from his sight. Everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.

verses.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
verses.ko: 그런즉 우리에게 하늘을 통과하신 큰 대제사장이 계시니 곧 하나님의 아들 예수시라, 우리가 고백하는 바를 굳게 붙들지니라.
verses.ez: So then, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens — Jesus the Son of God — let us hold firmly to what we confess.

verses.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verses.ko: 우리에게 있는 대제사장은 우리의 연약함을 함께 느끼지 못하시는 분이 아니요, 모든 일에 우리와 같이 시험을 받으셨으나 죄는 없으시니라.
verses.ez: For our high priest is not one who cannot sympathize with our weaknesses. He was tempted in every way, just as we are — yet he did not sin.

verses.en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.ko: 그러므로 우리가 긍휼을 얻고 때를 따라 돕는 은혜를 얻기 위하여 담대히 은혜의 보좌 앞으로 나아갈지니라.
verses.ez: So let us come boldly to the throne of grace, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

title: A Priest for Ever after the Order of Melchisedec

verses.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.ko: 무릇 대제사장은 사람 가운데서 택함을 받아 사람을 위하여 하나님께 속한 일을 맡았으니, 곧 죄를 위하여 예물과 제사를 드리게 하려 함이라.
verses.ez: Every high priest is chosen from among the people and appointed to represent them in matters related to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.

verses.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
verses.ko: 그는 무지하고 길을 잃은 자들을 능히 자비로이 대할 수 있나니, 이는 자기도 연약함에 둘러싸여 있음이라.
verses.ez: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, since he himself is also surrounded by weakness.

verses.en: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.ko: 또한 이로 인하여 그가 백성을 위함같이 자기를 위하여도 죄를 위한 제사를 드림이 마땅하니라.
verses.ez: That is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins as well as for the sins of the people.

verses.en: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
verses.ko: 아무도 이 존귀를 스스로 취하지 못하고 오직 아론과 같이 하나님께 부르심을 받은 자라야 하느니라.
verses.ez: And no one takes this honor for himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.

verses.en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
verses.ko: 이와 같이 그리스도께서도 대제사장 되심을 스스로 영광으로 삼지 아니하시고, 오직 그에게 이르신 분께서 영광을 주셨으니 곧 "너는 내 아들이라, 오늘 내가 너를 낳았도다" 하신 분이시며,
verses.ez: In the same way, Christ did not take on himself the glory of becoming high priest. It was given by the one who said to him, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father."

verses.en: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.ko: 또 다른 곳에서 이르시되 "너는 멜기세덱의 반차를 따른 영원한 제사장이라" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: And in another place he says, "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

verses.en: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
verses.ko: 그는 육신으로 계실 때에 자기를 죽음에서 능히 구원하실 분께 심한 통곡과 눈물로 기도와 간구를 올리셨고, 그 경외하심으로 인하여 들으심을 입으셨느니라.
verses.ez: While Jesus was here on earth, he offered prayers and pleadings, with loud crying and tears, to the one who could save him from death. And God heard his prayers because of his reverence.

verses.ko: 그가 아들이시지만 받으신 고난으로 순종함을 배우셨고,
verses.ez: Even though he was a Son, he learned obedience from what he suffered.

verses.ko: 또한 온전하게 되셨은즉 자기에게 순종하는 모든 자에게 영원한 구원의 근원이 되시고,

verses.ez: And God designated him high priest in the order of Melchizedek.

verses.en: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
verses.ko: 멜기세덱에 관하여는 우리가 할 말이 많으나, 너희가 듣는 데 둔하므로 풀어 말하기 어렵도다.
verses.ez: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you have become dull of hearing.

verses.en: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.ko: 때로 보면 너희가 마땅히 선생이 되었을 터인데 도리어 하나님의 말씀의 첫 원리를 누가 다시 너희에게 가르쳐야 할 처지가 되었으니, 단단한 음식이 아니라 젖을 필요로 하는 자가 되었도다.
verses.ez: By this time you ought to be teachers, but you need someone to teach you again the first principles of God's word. You have come to need milk, not solid food.

verses.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
verses.ko: 무릇 젖을 먹는 자마다 의의 말씀에 익숙하지 못하니, 이는 그가 어린아이임이라.
verses.ez: Anyone who lives on milk is still an infant and is not experienced in the word of righteousness.

verses.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
verses.ko: 그러나 단단한 음식은 장성한 자들의 것이니, 곧 지각을 단련하여 선악을 분별하는 자들의 것이니라.
verses.ez: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.

title: Let Us Go On unto Perfection

verses.en: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
verses.ko: 그러므로 우리가 그리스도의 도의 초보를 떠나 완전한 데로 나아갈지니, 죽은 행실로부터의 회개와 하나님을 향한 믿음의 터를 다시 닦지 말며,
verses.ez: So let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith in God.

verses.en: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.ko: 침례들과 안수와 죽은 자의 부활과 영원한 심판에 관한 교훈의 터를 다시 닦지 말지니라.
verses.ez: Nor the teaching about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

verses.en: And this will we do, if God permit.
verses.ko: 하나님께서 허락하시면 우리가 이것을 행하리라.
verses.ez: And God permitting, this is what we will do.

verses.en: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
verses.ko: 한번 빛을 받고 하늘의 은사를 맛보고 성령에 참여한 바 되고,
verses.ez: For it is impossible to restore those who were once enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, and who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

verses.en: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
verses.ko: 또 하나님의 선한 말씀과 장차 올 세상의 능력을 맛보고도,
verses.ez: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age,

verses.en: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
verses.ko: 타락한 자들은 다시 새롭게 하여 회개하게 할 수 없나니, 이는 그들이 하나님의 아들을 스스로 다시 십자가에 못 박아 드러내어 욕되게 함이라.
verses.ez: and who then fall away — to bring them back to repentance, because to their own loss they are crucifying the Son of God all over again and holding him up to public shame.

verses.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
verses.ko: 땅이 그 위에 자주 내리는 비를 흡수하여 그것을 가꾸는 자들에게 합당한 채소를 내면 하나님께 복을 받거니와,
verses.ez: For land that drinks in the rain that often falls on it, and that produces a crop useful to those who farm it, receives the blessing of God.

verses.en: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
verses.ko: 가시와 엉겅퀴를 내면 버림을 당하고 저주에 가까우니 그 끝은 불사름이 되리라.
verses.ez: But land that bears thorns and thistles is worthless and is in danger of being cursed. In the end it will be burned.

title: Things That Accompany Salvation

verses.en: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
verses.ko: 사랑하는 자들아, 우리가 이같이 말하나 너희에 대하여는 더 좋은 것 곧 구원에 속한 것을 확신하노라.
verses.ez: Dear friends, even though we speak like this, we are convinced of better things in your case — things that belong to salvation.

verses.en: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.ko: 하나님은 불의하지 아니하사 너희의 행위와 또 너희가 성도를 섬겼고 지금도 섬김으로 그의 이름을 위하여 나타낸 사랑의 수고를 잊지 아니하시느니라.
verses.ez: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.

verses.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
verses.ko: 우리가 간절히 원하는 것은 너희 각 사람이 끝까지 동일한 부지런함을 나타내어 소망의 온전한 확신에 이르고,
verses.ez: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, so that your hope may be fully assured.

verses.en: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.ko: 게으르지 아니하며 믿음과 오래 참음으로 약속들을 상속받는 자들을 본받는 것이라.
verses.ez: We do not want you to become lazy, but to imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.

verses.en: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
verses.ko: 하나님께서 아브라함에게 약속하실 때에 자기보다 더 큰 이를 두고 맹세할 수 없으므로 자기를 가리켜 맹세하여,
verses.ez: When God made his promise to Abraham, since there was no one greater for him to swear by, he swore by himself.

verses.en: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
verses.ko: 이르시되 "내가 반드시 네게 복 주고 복 주며 너를 번성하게 하고 번성하게 하리라" 하셨느니라.
verses.ez: He said, "I will surely bless you and give you many descendants."

title: An Anchor of the Soul, Both Sure and Stedfast

verses.en: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.ko: 이같이 아브라함이 오래 참아 그 약속을 받았느니라.
verses.ez: And so, after waiting patiently, Abraham received what was promised.

verses.en: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
verses.ko: 사람들은 진실로 자기보다 더 큰 이를 가리켜 맹세하나니, 맹세는 그들에게 모든 다툼을 끝맺는 확증이 되느니라.
verses.ez: People swear by someone greater than themselves, and the oath confirms what is said and puts an end to all argument.

verses.en: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
verses.ko: 이에 하나님께서 약속을 상속받을 자들에게 자기 뜻의 변하지 아니함을 더욱 풍성히 보이고자 하사 맹세로 보증하셨으니,
verses.ez: Because God wanted to make the unchanging nature of his purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, he confirmed it with an oath.

verses.en: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
verses.ko: 이는 하나님께서 거짓말하실 수 없는 변하지 아니하는 두 가지 일로 말미암아, 앞에 두신 소망을 붙잡으려고 피난처로 달려간 우리가 큰 위로를 받게 하려 하심이라.
verses.ez: So that by two unchangeable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be greatly encouraged.

verses.en: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
verses.ko: 우리에게 이 소망이 있는 것은 영혼의 닻과 같아서 든든하고 견고하며 또 휘장 안에 들어가나니,
verses.ez: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,

verses.en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.ko: 그리로 앞서 가신 분 곧 멜기세덱의 반차를 따라 영원한 대제사장이 되신 예수께서 우리를 위하여 들어가셨느니라.
verses.ez: where Jesus, who went before us, has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.

title: Melchisedec, King of Salem, Priest of the Most High God
titleKo: 멜기세덱 — 살렘 왕, 지극히 높으신 하나님의 제사장

verses.en: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.ko: 이 멜기세덱은 살렘 왕이요 지극히 높으신 하나님의 제사장이라, 아브라함이 여러 왕을 쳐부수고 돌아올 때에 그를 맞이하여 복을 빌었고,
verses.ez: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of the Most High God. He met Abraham returning from the defeat of the kings and blessed him.

verses.en: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.ko: 아브라함은 모든 것의 십분의 일을 그에게 나누어 주었으니, 그의 이름을 해석하면 첫째는 의의 왕이요 또한 살렘 왕이니 곧 평강의 왕이라.
verses.ez: And Abraham gave him a tenth of everything. First, his name means "king of righteousness"; then also, "king of Salem" means "king of peace."

verses.en: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
verses.ko: 그는 아버지도 없고 어머니도 없고 족보도 없으며 날의 시작도 생명의 끝도 없어 하나님의 아들과 닮았으니, 항상 제사장으로 있느니라.
verses.ez: Without father or mother, without genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, resembling the Son of God, he remains a priest forever.

verses.en: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.ko: 이 사람이 얼마나 큰가를 생각해 보라, 족장 아브라함도 노략물 가운데서 십분의 일을 그에게 주었느니라.
verses.ez: Just think how great he was: even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.

verses.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.ko: 과연 레위의 아들들 가운데 제사장의 직분을 받은 자들은 율법을 따라 백성 곧 자기 형제들에게서 십일조를 받으라는 명령을 가졌으니, 그 형제들도 아브라함의 허리에서 나왔거니와,
verses.ez: Now the law requires the descendants of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people — that is, from their brothers — even though their brothers are also descended from Abraham.

verses.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
verses.ko: 족보가 그들에게서 나지 아니한 이 사람은 아브라함에게서 십일조를 받고 약속들을 받은 자에게 복을 빌었느니라.
verses.ez: But this man, whose genealogy is not traced from them, collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

verses.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.ko: 논란의 여지 없이 낮은 자가 높은 자에게 복을 받느니라.
verses.ez: And without doubt, the lesser person is blessed by the greater.

title: The Priesthood Changed, the Law Changed

verses.en: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.ko: 여기서는 죽을 사람들이 십일조를 받으나, 거기서는 산다고 증거를 받은 이가 받느니라.
verses.ez: In the one case, the tenth is collected by men who die; but in the other case, by him who is declared to be living.

verses.en: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.ko: 또한 말하자면 십일조를 받는 레위도 아브라함을 통하여 십일조를 바쳤다 할 수 있나니,
verses.ez: One might even say that Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham.

verses.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
verses.ko: 이는 멜기세덱이 아브라함을 맞이할 때에 레위가 아직 자기 조상의 허리에 있었음이라.
verses.ez: For Levi was still in the body of his ancestor when Melchizedek met Abraham.

verses.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.ko: 만일 레위 계통의 제사장 직분으로 온전함을 이룰 수 있었다면 (백성이 이 직분 아래서 율법을 받았느니라) 어찌하여 아론의 반차를 따르지 않고 멜기세덱의 반차를 따른 다른 제사장을 세울 필요가 있었으리요?
verses.ez: If perfection could have come through the Levitical priesthood — for on that basis the people received the law — why was there still need for another priest to come, one in the order of Melchizedek, not in the order of Aaron?

verses.en: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.ko: 제사장의 직분이 바뀌면 율법도 반드시 바뀌어야 하느니라.
verses.ez: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed also.

verses.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.ko: 이런 말씀을 받은 이는 다른 지파에 속하였으니, 그 지파에서는 아무도 제단을 섬긴 자가 없었느니라.
verses.ez: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the altar.

verses.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

title: After the Power of an Endless Life

verses.en: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
verses.ko: 멜기세덱과 같은 모양으로 다른 한 제사장이 일어났은즉 이것이 더욱 분명하도다.
verses.ez: And what we have said is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,

verses.en: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.ko: 그는 육신에 속한 계명의 법을 따라 되신 것이 아니요 무궁한 생명의 능력을 따라 되셨느니라.
verses.ez: one who has become a priest not on the basis of a law about physical descent, but on the basis of the power of an indestructible life.

verses.en: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.ko: 이는 증거하여 이르시되 "너는 멜기세덱의 반차를 따른 영원한 제사장이라" 하셨음이라.
verses.ez: For it is declared: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

verses.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.ko: 과연 앞서 있던 계명은 그 연약하고 무익함으로 인하여 폐하여지나니,
verses.ez: The former commandment is set aside because it was weak and useless.

verses.en: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
verses.ko: 이는 율법이 아무것도 온전하게 하지 못하였음이라. 그러나 더 좋은 소망이 들어왔으니 우리가 이로 말미암아 하나님께 가까이 나아가느니라.
verses.ez: For the law made nothing perfect; but a better hope has been brought in, by which we draw near to God.

verses.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
verses.ko: 또 그가 맹세 없이 제사장이 되신 것이 아니니,
verses.ez: And it was not without an oath that he became a priest.

verses.en: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
verses.ko: 저 제사장들은 맹세 없이 되었으되 이분은 자기에게 말씀하신 분의 맹세로 되셨으니, 곧 "주께서 맹세하시고 뜻을 돌이키지 아니하시리니 너는 영원한 제사장이라" 하심이라.
verses.ez: Others became priests without any oath, but he became a priest with an oath, by the one who said to him: "The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: 'You are a priest forever.'"

title: Able to Save Them to the Uttermost
titleKo: 온전히 구원하실 수 있는 영원한 대제사장

verses.en: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
verses.ko: 이만큼 예수께서는 더 좋은 언약의 보증이 되셨느니라.
verses.ez: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

verses.en: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.ko: 또 저들은 죽음으로 인하여 계속할 수 없으므로 제사장 된 자가 많았으나,
verses.ez: There were many of those priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office.

verses.en: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.ko: 이분은 영원히 계시므로 변치 아니하는 제사장직을 가지셨느니라.
verses.ez: But because Jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

verses.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.ko: 그러므로 그가 자기로 말미암아 하나님께 나아오는 자들을 온전히 구원하실 수 있으니, 이는 그가 항상 살아 계셔서 그들을 위하여 간구하심이라.
verses.ez: Therefore he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

verses.en: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.ko: 이러한 대제사장은 우리에게 합당하니, 곧 거룩하고 악이 없고 더러움이 없고 죄인에게서 떠나 계시며 하늘보다 높이 되신 분이시라.
verses.ez: Such a high priest truly meets our need — one who is holy, blameless, pure, set apart from sinners, exalted above the heavens.

verses.en: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
verses.ko: 그는 저 대제사장들처럼 날마다 먼저 자기 죄를 위하고 그 다음에 백성의 죄를 위하여 제사를 드릴 필요가 없으니, 이는 그가 자기를 단번에 드리심으로 이 일을 이루셨음이라.
verses.ez: Unlike the other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices day after day, first for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He sacrificed for their sins once for all when he offered himself.

verses.en: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
verses.ko: 율법은 연약함을 지닌 사람들을 대제사장으로 세우거니와, 율법 후에 하신 맹세의 말씀은 영원히 온전하게 되신 아들을 세우셨느니라.
verses.ez: For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints the Son, who has been made perfect forever.

mem.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
mem.ko: 그러므로 그가 자기로 말미암아 하나님께 나아오는 자들을 온전히 구원하실 수 있으니, 이는 그가 항상 살아 계셔서 그들을 위하여 간구하심이라.
mem.tip: able to save → to the uttermost → ever liveth → intercession. 구원의 능력·범위·근거·방식이 한 절에 있습니다.
mem.deep: '온전히'(to the uttermost)는 깊이와 길이를 함께 뜻합니다. 아무리 밑바닥이라도, 아무리 끝까지라도 — 살아 계신 분이 기도하고 계시기 때문입니다.

spoon: 27절의 '단번에'(once)가 히브리서의 심장 박동입니다. 날마다 반복되는 제사는 끝나지 않은 일이라는 고백이지만, 단번의 제사는 끝났다는 선언입니다.
